units.text: 10月27日，有网友发现，苹果韩国官网展示的新款 iPad mini（A20 Pro）宣传图中未出现手部，而苹果中国官网同款产品的宣传图则展示了一只手捏住平板边缘的画面。两地页面呈现存在差异，引发关注。
苹果官网资料显示，新款 iPad mini 厚度为5.4毫米，搭载A20 Pro芯片，并采用OLED显示屏。中国官网的相关图片通过手指与机身的对比，直观呈现产品的纤薄设计；韩国官网对应图片则仅展示设备本身。
这一差异也引发了外界对苹果是否考虑当地文化敏感性的讨论。在韩国，拇指与食指捏合的手势曾多次引发争议。2023年，游戏公司Nexon旗下《冒险岛》宣传视频因被部分网民质疑出现类似手势而引发风波，相关动画制作方随后就争议致歉。
截至目前，苹果尚未公开说明韩国官网宣传图调整的原因。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，浏览器厂商 Opera 推出了一项名为 WebAI 的新 Web 标准，允许用户直接在浏览器中运行 AI 模型，无需依赖云端服务。 Opera 表示，WebAI 旨在兼容多种 AI 模型。该公司以谷歌（Google）的 Gemma 为例。这是一款由谷歌推出的开放权重模型，首次发布于两年前。Opera 还表示，在 Mac 电脑上，WebAI 支持调用苹果的端侧基础模型。 Opera 强调，WebAI 并不绑定任何特定模型，而是面向多种开放权重 AI 系统打造。该项目源于 Opera 此前将本地运行的大语言模型引入浏览器的相关工作。 目前，Opera 已在旗下主力浏览器 Opera One 中以早期预览版的形式推出这项 AI 功能。该公司表示，面向游戏玩家和直播用户的浏览器 Opera GX，以及能够利用 AI 智能体执行任务的浏览器 Opera Neon，也将在不久后获得相同功能。用户需要主动选择启用 WebAI，才能使用相关功能。 开放权重模型能为用户带来诸多好处。首先，这类模型通常可以免费下载和使用。其次，其底层模型权重会公开，开发者因此拥有更大的自由度，可以根据自身需求对模型进行定制。不过，与完全开源的软件不同，开放权重模型仍可能受到一定的使用和修改限制。 Opera 表示，隐私保护也是 WebAI 的一项重要优势。用户可以使用 AI 功能，而不必将个人信息发送到企业服务器，也无需付费订阅云端 AI 服务。 Opera 在公告中表示：“开发者可以在无需部署 AI 基础设施、也不必为每次请求付费的情况下，为产品添加 AI 功能。用户不需要购买 AI 订阅服务，本地 AI 处理的信息会保留在用户自己的设备上，用户也能继续掌控电脑上的 AI。” Opera 还表示，借助 WebAI，用户可以直接在浏览器中生成文本、对内容进行分类，并理解不同信息之间的关联。 IT之家注意到，随着 AI 助手的能力不断增强、能够访问的个人信息越来越多，隐私问题也日益受到关注。用户在使用 AI 聊天机器人时，往往会提供大量个人信息，有时却并不清楚这些数据会如何存储和使用。 本地运行的 AI 模型提供了另一种选择，因为所有处理工作都在用户自己的设备上完成，而不是交由企业的云服务器处理。这并不意味着所有隐私风险都能得到消除，但确实能让用户拥有更多控制权。因此，Opera 多年来一直将数字隐私保护作为其产品的主要卖点之一。 不过，本地运行 AI 模型也存在一定的取舍。由于模型需要直接使用用户电脑的计算资源，可能会增加硬件负载，进而影响设备运行性能。Opera 提醒，WebAI 的实际表现将取决于用户设备的硬件配置。

本地运行的 AI 模型提供了另一种选择，因为所有处理工作都在用户自己的设备上完成，而不是交由企业的云服务器处理。这并不意味着所有隐私风险都能得到消除，但确实能让用户拥有更多控制权。因此，Opera 多年来一直将数字隐私保护作为其产品的主要卖点之一。
不过，本地运行 AI 模型也存在一定的取舍。由于模型需要直接使用用户电脑的计算资源，可能会增加硬件负载，进而影响设备运行性能。Opera 提醒，WebAI 的实际表现将取决于用户设备的硬件配置。

units.text: iPhone Duo 拆解：最好修的折叠 iPhone，就是别撕膜
距离 iPhone Duo 正式发货已经过去三天了，面对这样一台「十九年来首款新形态」的 iPhone，市场的反响无疑是热烈的。
作为苹果蛰伏七年才端出来的 iPhone 历史上首款「新形态」产品，人们对于它的关注无非集中在两方面——硬件设计，与软件能力。
对于后者，我们从发布会到开售的这段时间的确见到了苹果的决心与号召力。
在 2027 年 4 月的 App Store 截止日期之前，各大应用开发商就以 Android 从未有过的待遇，提供了一轮又一轮的主动适配：
至于前者，虽然 iPhone Duo 的形态市场上早已有之，但它在内部设计上的巧思和取舍，直到近几天拆解内容陆续上线之后才为人所知。
首先需要承认的是，尽管 iPhone Duo 是一个全新形态的产品，但从它的内部设计与做工上讲，iPhone Duo 依然延续着苹果一直以来的优秀水准：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
哪怕 iPhone Duo 的物理外形没有什么「前无古人」的地方，但在机身内部，实际上藏着一些与市面上所有折叠屏手机都不相同、甚至是「苹果专属」的元素。
比如这张处于讨论中心的「纳米纹理表层」——
从形态上讲，它就是一张可以单独更换的屏幕贴膜，但就像所有其他折叠屏手机一样，哪怕你不喜欢，也千万不要撕掉这张出厂膜。
图｜YouTube @iFixit
因为纳米纹理层下方的屏幕不仅在材料强度上远不如纳米纹理层，上面也没有任何疏油层，从设计角度就不是用来裸露在外与手指接触的。
另外现在淘宝京东上出现了一些价格极为逆天的所谓「iPhone Duo 内屏膜」，这些是纯粹的智商税产品。
第二层膜不仅在纳米纹理层上粘不住，额外的厚度更是有可能导致屏幕挤压、弄坏屏幕，得不偿失：
图｜小红书
重点在于，iPhone Duo 的纳米纹理表层作为一项出厂特性，赋予了 iPhone Duo 在折叠屏市场上独一无二的观感，以及非常优秀的「隐藏」效果：
在大部分日常光线环境中，iPhone Duo 的纳米纹理层都可以在兼顾折痕隐藏的时候，提供一个几乎没有反光的一体化观感。
在更早的文章中我们提到过，折叠屏最大的意义在于提供一块一体化的大屏，而不是分割的小窗口。即使前面有那么多优秀产品先例，iPhone Duo 的磨砂内屏仍然是迄今为止「一体感」最强的那个。
除了外面的屏幕，iPhone Duo 机身内的钢壳电池也很有特色。
钢壳电池从 iPhone 16 Pro 首次亮相到今天，无论是在充放表现、耐用性还是安全性上，都有了相当明显的进步。
但对于 iPhone Duo 来说，钢壳电池最大的优势还得是空间利用率：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
由于不需要预留铝塑膜封边和膨胀空间，还可以通过精密冲压与激光焊接实现复杂的形状，iPhone 使用的钢壳电池可以让电池仓区域的整体空间利用率提升 10%～18% 左右。
而在寸土寸金的折叠屏里，这些空间比以往更加重要。
iPhone Duo 两块电池总容量来到了 19Wh 左右，都快赶上 iPhone 18 Pro Max 的 21Wh 电池了——
图｜YouTube @iFixit
并且 iPhone Duo 使用的电诱导粘合剂（Electrically Debondable Adhesive）依然是整个折叠屏市场中「最优雅」的拆电池方式。
用直流电源给电池胶和地点通一会电，电池胶就会完全失去粘性，既不用发热也没有破拆，安全性和便利性都远远高于传统电池胶：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
这种获得海内外拆解媒体一致好评的电敏式电池胶还不是 iPhone Duo 唯一为了可维修性考虑的方面。
iFixit 在拆解中提到，iPhone Duo 外屏使用的屏幕胶水粘性控制得很好，几乎完美地兼顾了粘合力与拆卸难度：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
Shahram Mokhtari（iFixit 首席拆解工程师）还评价道：作为一个经常需要维修的零件，以及所有拆机的起点，一个便于拆解的外屏是很有意义的。
尤其是苹果还在坚持着出售正版零件和官方维修工具（虽然很贵），我们可以推测，iPhone Duo 的正版零件后续也将出现在苹果 Self Service Repair 商店的页面里：
iPhone Duo 内部另一个有趣的地方是它的外屏前摄。
由于外屏这边无法从相机平台上「偷」空间，苹果订制了一颗厚度仅 1.91mm 的相机总成，加上镜头组的厚度也仅有 3.29mm。
图｜哔哩哔哩 @微机分WekiHome
为了极限压缩厚度，苹果采用了类似手机中框「破板下沉」工艺，将索尼 IMX915 传感器用金线固定在镂空的基板中间，录制规格依然是不缩水的 4K 60 杜比视界。
另据拆解，iPhone Duo 所使用的 X 轴线性马达体积约为 681.5 立方毫米。
这个体积刚好在 iPhone Air 与 iPhone 18 Pro 之间，面对超过半斤的机身也能提供足够的手感：
图｜哔哩哔哩 @微机分WekiHome
根据爱范儿体验，iPhone Duo 的马达调教依然称得上是目前所有折叠屏手机中最出色的那一档。
不仅 iOS 27 系统的震感反馈丰富，也继承了苹果一直以来的优秀启停控制，在大机身上也几乎没有那种「迟滞感」：
但在细节之外，在折叠屏的关键部件——也就是铰链上，iPhone Duo 却又变得「成熟」起来。
从 iFixit 的拆解中可以看到，iPhone Duo 使用了四组弹簧作为扭力结构，相比三星 Z Fold8 少了两组，但在手感均匀性和阻力分段上依然调教得很优秀：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
并且 iPhone Duo 拥有很多 Z Fold8 没有的悬停功能场景，也侧面说明苹果选择了稍微不同的凸轮轴设计方案，让发售前一些「iPhone Duo 约等于换壳 Z Fold8」的评价不攻自破：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
然而 iPhone Duo 和 Z Fold8 都面临一个共同的挑战：铰链防尘。
在 iFixit 的粉尘侵入测试中，iPhone Duo 表现出了与 Z Fold8 非常相似的侵入问题，粉末沿着转轴盖与机身的缝隙侵入之后会造成铰链移动不畅和异响：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
严格来说，iPhone Duo 标称的 IP68 防护要求「滑石粉沙尘箱 8 小时测试内部无可见尘埃沉积」，两侧机身确实没有被粉尘侵入，但铰链进灰的风险依然是客观存在的。
并且苹果为了追求视觉平整，没有像市面上其他折叠屏手机那样在铰链两端安装那个半圆形的防尘盖。
这样虽然视觉和手感更好，但是在 iFixit 的测试中，我们可以明显看到 iPhone Duo 缺少防尘盖的铰链缝隙处出现了粉末堆积：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
放在日常生活中，就相当于你口袋里的碎屑、衣服上的细毛、空气中的沙尘，都有可能被「暂存」在这个空隙里，增加进灰的风险。
另外虽然无法确定是否有直接关联，iFixit 也针对最近 iPhone Duo 屏幕故障的现象提出了一种解释。
iFixit 通过拆解认为，现有屏幕案例中出现的损坏位置，刚好对应 iPhone Duo 铰链中心枢轴连接板、屏幕排线和钢壳电池边缘交汇的区域，这块连接板需要在折叠过程中微微下沉、给屏幕留出弯曲的空间。
iFixit 猜测，如果在手机闭合时连接板下沉距离不对或者有延迟，叠加如果有沙尘之类的异物进入铰链区域，弯曲的屏幕就可能会压在那一点上，导致受损：
图｜YouTube @iFixit
总之，如果你已经入手了 iPhone Duo 打算做主力机，爱范儿还是建议加购一个 AppleCare+，以实现更完善的保护。
如果你还没买 iPhone Duo 或者还在等待发货，也不妨趁现在的机会重新考虑一下——
毕竟综合来看，iPhone Duo 等几个月再入手才是最合适的选择，不仅价格会更合适，第三方 app 适配也会跟上。
但不管怎么说，iPhone Duo 是有它作为一款产品的特殊价值的。
无论现在的安卓折叠屏市场多热闹，iPhone Duo 最大的价值就是让很多根本不看「非 iPhone」的人第一次开始关注和了解折叠屏这个品类——
比如在折叠屏面世 7 年后的今天，还需要科普「不要撕内屏膜」就是明显的例子。
但在另一方面，iPhone Duo 同时也是一个集成了大量行业成熟方案的产品。
尽管里面有苹果的独特坚持与独家技术，但它却没有多少没有初代 iPhone 身上「带来魔法」般的感觉。
就像乔布斯借用毕加索的那句话：好的艺术家模仿，伟大的艺术家窃取——苹果应该抓紧在折叠屏领域里，向「好艺术家」们「窃取」更多的成熟经验了。

units.text: The MacBook Pro line has graduated to M6, with the 14-inch entry-level model getting a timely performance boost. Here's how the new model compares to the previous model.
The M5 14-inch MacBook Pro was introduced in October 2025 as a replacement for the M4 version. It's only been a year, but Apple's done the same thing again, this time to the M6.
The change takes the form of the typical spec-bump update, which is chiefly a performance improvement change rather than one introducing brand new features.

To be frank, with expectations of an OLED variant on the way, there's no real reason to make any changes to the non-OLED model. But, as ever, the chip upgrade warrants a wider look at the new current model and the previous one.
What follows is a comparison of the base M5 14-inch MacBook Pro against the new M5 14-inch MacBook Pro.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Specifications
Specifications | M6 MacBook Pro (14-inch, 2026) | M5 MacBook Pro (14-inch, 2025)
Launch Starting Price | $1,999 Best prices | $1,599 (Later $1,999) Best prices
Dimensions (inches) | 12.31 x 8.71 x 0.61 | 12.31 x 8.71 x 0.61
Weight (pounds) | 3.4 | 3.4
Display | 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR, Wide Color (P3) True Tone ProMotion, Nano-texture (optional) | 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR, Wide Color (P3) True Tone ProMotion, Nano-texture (optional)
Brightness | 1,000 nits sustained fullscreen, 1,600 nits peak HDR, 1,000 nits SDR | 1,000 nits sustained fullscreen, 1,600 nits peak HDR, 1,000 nits SDR
Processor | Apple M6 12-Core | Apple M5 10-Core
Graphics | 12-core GPU | 10-core GPU
Memory | 16GB, 24GB, 32GB | 16GB, 24GB, 32GB
Storage | 512GB, 1TB, 2TB, 4TB | 512GB (Later removed) 1TB, 2TB, 4TB
Battery | 72.4Wh lithium-polymer | 72.4Wh lithium-polymer
Networking | Wi-Fi 7 Bluetooth 6 | Wi-Fi 6E Bluetooth 5.3
Touch ID | Yes | Yes
Camera | 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View | 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View

Audio | Six-speaker sound system, Force-cancelling woofers, Three-mic array with directional beamforming and high signal-to-noise ratio, Headphone jack with high-impedance headphone support, Dolby Atmos support with Spatial Audio | Six-speaker sound system, Force-cancelling woofers, Three-mic array with directional beamforming and high signal-to-noise ratio, Headphone jack with high-impedance headphone support, Dolby Atmos support with Spatial Audio
Ports | Three Thunderbolt 4 ports, SDXC Card Slot HDMI 3.5mm headphone, MagSafe 3 | Three Thunderbolt 4 ports, SDXC Card Slot HDMI 3.5mm headphone, MagSafe 3
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Design, weight, size
The MacBook Pro has a very well-defined design, namely Apple's aluminum slab aesthetic. It's quite fond of its designs, and doesn't like to change them that much if it can help it.
The M5 MacBook Pro measures 12.31 inches long by 8.71 inches wide, just like the M4 version. Its thickness of 0.61 inches was also identical, and keeps the design fairly thin for a notebook.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Closed, from the front, the M6 is just as thin as the M5 version. - Image Credit: Apple
The only change introduced during the M5 launch was a new Space Black colorway replacing Grey alongside Silver.
As usual for a spec-bump update, the footprint of the M6 version is exactly the same size, as well as thickness.
For weight, there's also no real difference here. The M5 MacBook Pro was 3.4 pounds, which the M6 also matches.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Display
While there is the considerable prospect of an OLED display on the horizon, it is evident that Apple still wants to sell its current MacBook display tech to consumers.
The M5 reused the M4 model's display, meaning it has a 14.2-inch screen with a resolution of 3,024 by 1,964. The pixel density of 254 pixels per inch is typical of Apple's MacBook lineup.
The XDR screen benefited from mini LED backlighting, enabling a million-to-one contrast ratio. Brightness hit 1,000 nits for SDR content, 1,600 nits at a peak for HDR content.
The M5 model also supported a billion colors, Wide Color (P3) gamut, and True Tone. ProMotion enabled refresh rates to adapt, going as high as 120 Hz.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Front view. - Image Credit: Apple
Unsurprisingly, all of this is mirrored in the M6 MacBook Pro, too.
That also includes the dreaded notch, located at the top of the screen and holding a camera. The M5 introduced an optional Nano-texture coating to minimize glare, which the M6 retains.
For external display support, the M5 was able to handle two 6K-resolution 60Hz displays using Thunderbolt. Using the HDMI, you could run an 8K 60Hz display, or a 4K one at 240Hz.
The M6 can do the same thing with external displays.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Performance

The M5 in the previous 14-inch MacBook Pro had ten CPU cores, consisting of four super cores and six efficiency cores. It was joined by a 16-core Neural Engine, a 10-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, and a Media Engine.
The switch to the M6 brings many performance-related changes. Starting with the CPU, which is a 12-core version, with the usual claims of speed improvements over the previous generation.
The core mix this time is described as two super cores, four performance cores, and six efficiency cores.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: The M6 has a performance bump on the M5. - Image Credit: Apple

The Neural Engine is back again, but this time it's a "Dual 16-core" version, meaning it has 32 cores to play with. You can add on top of that the Neural Accelerators in the 12-core GPU, as well as the usual Media Engine for hardware-accelerated video encoding and decoding.
Then there's memory bandwidth. For the M5, there was 153GB/s available, but this has been increased to 170GB/s in the M6.

When it comes to performance, Apple claims the M6 model has 1.3 times the render performance in Blender than the M5, 1.2 times faster image processing in Affinity, and 1.3 times faster Xcode code compilation. For the growing AI processing needs of its audience, there's a 1.3 times improvement too.
We can't immediately benchmark the M6 MacBook Pro just yet. However, we can use the M6 Mac mini to give some idea of what to expect in terms of performance gains.
It's not going to be an exact match for the MacBook Pro due to various factors, such as thermal management differences. Even so, it will still provide a ballpark figure.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Single-core benchmarks
For single-core performance in Geekbench 7's listings, the M5 MacBook Pro achieves a pretty good 3,647. The M6 Mac mini, however, does 9.7% better at 4,002.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Multi-core benchmarks
The multi-core benchmark is less tight, with the 17,955 of the M5 beaten by the M6's 21,881. That's a 22% margin that can be partially explained by the extra two cores in the M6.
Lastly, graphics, with the M5 MacBook Pro's score of 72,726 still pretty respectable. However, the 89,375 of the M6 Mac mini is a 23% improvement again.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Metal benchmarks
We know there will be a performance improvement going from the M5 to the M6, as is usual for a new generation. While there's a bit of a jump from each, it's not a bad performance for the M5 at all.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Camera and Audio

The notch of the M5 14-inch MacBook Pro included an improved 12MP Center Stage camera. As the name implied, the camera would reframe the shot so the subject was in the middle, making it extremely handy for video calls.
That 1080p video feed, boosted by an advanced image signal processor, also had Desk View, which faked a top-down view of the desk.
Evidently, Apple decided this worked well enough not to change. It's the same camera in the M6 version.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: The ports, like the rest of the design, are unchanged. - Image Credit: Apple

For audio, the M5 and the M6 both use a high-fidelity six-speaker sound system with force-cancelling woofers. There was also Spatial Audio support for Dolby Atmos content, both through speakers and with AirPods using Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking.
The M5 had a headphone jack capable of working with high-impedance headphones, making it great for audiophiles. This too is maintained for the M6 model.

When it comes to audio recording, the M5 MacBook Pro used an array of three "studio-quality" microphones with a high signal-to-noise ratio and directional beamforming. These persist in the M6 with the same specifications.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Storage, connectivity, power
The M5 MacBook Pro included 512GB of storage at its lowest, with upgrade options for 1TB, 2TB, and 4TB. In March 2026, it cut the 512GB option, leaving the 1TB to 4TB range intact.
For M6, Apple's maintaining this later range, with the lowest capacity at 1TB.

On the physical connectivity side, there are three Thunderbolt 4 ports on both models, along with HDMI and an SDXC memory card slot, as well as the headphone jack. MagSafe 3 is also present for charging duties on both models.
14" MacBook Pro M5
Apple's 2025 14-inch MacBook Pro has an M5 chip and is equipped with three Thunderbolt 4 ports.
Buy at Amazon
Buy at B&H
Buy at Expercom

The wireless connectivity on the M5 14-inch MacBook Pro consisted of Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 for accessories. Under the M6, these have been upgraded to Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, though those will only really be beneficial if you have similarly-supportive accessories or wireless network infrastructure.
When it comes to power, the M5 model had a 72.4-watt-hour lithium-polymer battery. Apple claimed it could last for up to 24 hours of video streaming and up to 16 hours of wireless web access.
This hasn't changed at all with the M6.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Pricing

The base 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5 launched at $1,599, but the global memory crisis had other ideas. The price for the base model rose to $1,999, with the Standard Display, M5 chip, 16GB of unified memory, and 1TB of storage.
Increasing the memory to 24GB cost $200, rising by another $200 for the 32GB maximum. If you wanted more storage, the upgrade to 2TB was $500, while 4TB was another $1,000 on top of that.
The included 70W USB-C adapter could also be upgraded to a 96W version for just $20, while Nano-texture was $150.
The new M6 14-inch MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 with the Standard Display, 16GB of memory, and 1TB of storage.
The memory upgrade jumps are again $200 to 24GB and $200 more to 32GB. Likewise, going to 2TB of storage is a $500 fee, and 4TB another $1,000 beyond that.
The charger upgrade is once more $20, with Nano-texture a $150 upgrade.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: Which to buy?
When it comes to buying a base MacBook Pro from Apple directly, you don't really have much choice in the matter. You're stuck with whatever the newest chip is, which in this case is the M6.

It's also a spec-bump update through and through, with very few internal changes instead of anything major and exterior. That puts the M6 model into the bracket of being aimed at consumers who absolutely need to upgrade, or are buying their first MacBook Pro.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 MacBook Pro: It's faster and better, but no OLED yet. - Image Credit: Apple
There is no realistic reason to upgrade from the M5 to the M6. Things like the Neural Accelerators helped justify people upgrading to the M5, but this time it's a more muted jump up.

It also doesn't help the M6 that it's in the shadow of a rumored launch of an OLED MacBook Pro. For people wanting a serious upgrade from the M5 MacBook Pro, that is what they will be watching out for, not a small upgrade.
That all said, the M6 has still earned its place as being a pretty good entry-level MacBook Pro, for those who want something a little meatier than a MacBook Air.
Where to buy Apple's M6 14-inch MacBook Pro and M5 14-inch MacBook Pro
Apple's new M6 14-inch MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 and will be available to preorder on October 28, 2026 at B&H Photo and Amazon.
The closeout M5 14-inch MacBook Pro, meanwhile, is currently on sale from $1,837 at Amazon. A full rundown of the deals and availability can be found in our M5 14-inch MacBook Pro Price Guide.

units.text: 限制“摇一摇”跳转广告的功能正式登陆苹果手机。10月27日，苹果推送iOS 27.2正式版更新。此前在测试版中出现的限制“摇一摇”广告功能得以保留，且为中国大陆地区用户提供。与此同时，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo也获得专属系统更新，新增Apple Pencil支持、视频通话补光等功能。
此次新增的功能名为“限制动作数据”。用户进入“设置”-“隐私与安全”-“运动与健身”，找到“限制动作数据”选项并点击右上角“编辑”，即可将希望屏蔽“摇一摇”跳转广告的App加入限制名单。被限制的应用将无法访问相关运动数据，从而阻断部分应用通过识别手机晃动动作触发广告跳转的路径。
这项功能最早于9月中旬出现在iOS 27.2 Beta 2测试版中。
9月23日，澎湃新闻记者实测发现，以百度地图为例，打开应用后，轻微晃动手机便可能跳转至广告对应的应用；将百度地图加入限制名单后，即使开屏广告仍然出现，随意晃动也不会触发跳转。彼时，该功能尚处于开发者测试阶段，苹果方面未确认是否会在正式版中保留。如今，随着正式版推送，这项功能得以落地。
“摇一摇”广告引发争议，主要在于其触发机制容易造成误操作。
根据工人日报9月22日报道，一名软件开发从业者向记者介绍，“摇一摇”跳转类型的广告，主要是通过读取手机加速传感器、陀螺仪，算法判断摇动动作，一旦达标就执行跳转。
按照相关从业者的说法，部分App将传感器触发灵敏度设置在临界值甚至直接调高，用户走路时的自然晃动、乘车时的轻微颠簸，都可能被识别为主动摇动。
在黑猫投诉平台上，关于“摇一摇”的投诉已达上千条，涉及开屏广告误触、跳转至付款页面以及广告难以跳过等问题。
值得注意的是，苹果开发者协议早已明确，App不得将Motion & Fitness APIs或通过这些接口获得的信息，用于健康、运动、健身服务以外的目的，例如广告投放。运动数据包括设备的加速度、姿态、旋转和磁场等信息。此次更新的意义在于，苹果进一步将相关权限控制交给用户，让用户可以针对特定App限制其访问运动数据，从系统层面切断部分“摇一摇”广告的触发条件。
不过，这一功能并不等于彻底屏蔽开屏广告。被列入限制名单的App仍可能展示广告，只是无法再通过相关运动数据触发部分摇动跳转。对于依赖运动传感器提供导航、健身等服务的应用，用户也需要权衡限制权限可能带来的影响。
除了“限制动作数据”，iOS 27.2还为iPhone Duo增加USB-C Apple Pencil支持，方便用户进行书写、标注等操作；新增Edge Light（边缘补光）功能，可在视频通话时利用屏幕为用户面部补光。

units.text: Here’s a welcome change. OpenAI just announced iCloud Mail and Calendar plugin support for ChatGPT. That means you can connect ChatGPT to your Apple email and calendar just like Gmail and other services.
For iCloud Mail and Calendar users, this should hopefully enable connecting ChatGPT features like the proactive agent Dots feature for the first time.

For now, the post announcement specifically mentions ChatGPT compatibility on the web, desktop, and iOS. Various ChatGPT features don’t always work together as expected to start out, so we’ll need to test and see how far this extends through the app’s features like Dots, Work, and Codex.
Each plugin requires signing in with an app-specific password, similar to third-party mail and calendar apps that work with iCloud Mail and Calendar.

Much requested, and now yours to connect: iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins are available in ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to find that email, catch up on your inbox, check what’s next, or update a calendar event. Phew. Available on all ChatGPT plans on web, desktop, and iOS. pic.twitter.com/g68OWoFVg8
— ChatGPT (@ChatGPT) October 27, 2026
Update: Yes, both plugins enable ChatGPT Dot compatibility for the first time. You can even ask a ChatGPT Dot to help set up the iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins.

IT之家附上苹果官方更新日志内容如下：
本次更新带来了使用 FaceTime 保持联系、个性化屏幕保护程序以及使用“查找”功能定位 Siri Remote 的新方式，同时还修复了 Apple TV 4K 的错误并进行了安全更新。
FaceTime
FaceTime 连接功能让您可以直接通过 Apple TV 加入通话，更加便捷。
手语翻译和字幕支持功能可让您在通话中添加第三方服务。
屏幕保护程序
无需与 Apple TV 共享您的整个图库，照片个性化功能支持用户使用 iPhone 选择特定照片作为屏幕保护程序。
在 Apple TV 循环播放不同类别的屏幕保护程序时，随机播放选项可让用户享受不同的屏幕保护程序。
Find My
“查找”功能可让您使用 iPhone 定位 Siri Remote（第二代）以及后续版本。
对经常找不到遥控器的用户而言，最实用的变化是“查找”应用支持定位第二代及更新版 Siri Remote。用户可用 iPhone 查找遥控器，但“精准查找”目前仅限第四代 Siri Remote，后者配备更精确的定位能力。

units.text: 快科技10月28日消息，苹果在韩国官网宣传推广新款OLED iPad mini（A20 Pro）时，将宣传图中捏住平板的手指移除，只保留设备本身，同一张图片在中国和美国官网正常显示手指捏住平板的形态，用于展示5.4mm超薄机身。
原因在于这个手势本身，在韩国食指和拇指捏成"C"形的手势，会被部分人群视为冒犯性手势，此前冒险岛游戏宣传片中出现过类似C形手势，开发商Nexon被迫公开道歉。
苹果原图中握住iPad的手势与该手势存在相似之处，苹果显然认为不值得冒险。
这并非苹果首次进行在韩国进行此类调整，iPhone Air发布时苹果也做过类似处理，表明苹果可能已将这一手势视为固定检查项，而非临时补救。
对全球品牌而言，判断出错的代价远高于编辑一张图片，删掉手几乎不费成本，却能避免社交媒体声讨和尴尬道歉。

从目前公开的用户反馈来看，部分iPhone Duo是在正常展开过程中出现异常，而非跌落或撞击损坏。这意味着，故障可能与折叠结构或屏幕本身的可靠性有关，而非单纯的使用不当。
随后苹果发布声明，承认少量iPhone Duo存在内屏故障，并建议用户联系AppleCare申请更换。对用户来说，想要换机并没有想象中那么容易。
据媒体报道，美国弗吉尼亚州一名用户表示，当地门店确认故障属于产品缺陷，但售后服务预约已满。他转至另一家门店完成检测后，又因缺货至今仍在等待。检测、预约、等配件，多个环节叠加在一起，让换机流程变得漫长。
无独有偶，沈阳短视频博主宋温暖去苹果售后时被告知，即便是付费也无法维修iPhone Duo。店里没有配件，不知道什么时候到货，售后只能先帮忙登记。该博主提醒已经购买的朋友们：好好保护好自己的iPhone Duo，坏了修不上。

对苹果而言，首款折叠屏能否站稳，不仅取决于首发热度，更取决于后续品控和售后体系能否跟上。

evidence.title: iPhone Duo hinge maker denies blame for screen failures

units.text: An Apple supplier insists that its components aren't the cause of hinge failures that break the screen of the iPhone Duo, as the social media fallout over the fault rolls on.

Following the release of the iPhone Duo, there have been reports of screen breakages, with quite a few highlighting a very common point of failure for the hinge. In an attempt to get ahead of the story, part of Apple's supply chain claims that its components are not the problem.

A statement from Fine M-Tec released on October 26 denies that its components cause the screen damage, reports The Elec. It also urges everyone to avoid a witch hunt for someone to blame until the real cause has been uncovered.

"The quality issues recently reported in certain products were not caused by defects in components supplied by our company," Fine M-Tec insists, without directly mentioning Apple. The supplier adds that it is also considering legal action against anyone making claims about its components without the issue being validated.

Fine M-Tec is a manufacturer of internal hinges and metal plates that are used to support foldable OLED displays. The intention of the plates are to help protect the panel from the stress of folding and unfolding.
The company is known as a supplier of components in that field to Samsung Display, and therefore is part of the foldable smartphone supply chain.
Oh Snap

Consumers and product testers of the destructive variety have repeatedly demonstrated in video and photographs that a fault can occur on the center line. While this is not exceptional on its own, there is a pattern of a horizontal line appearing at one particular point along the center of the display, which goes off to one side.
A closer examination and disassembly of the iPhone Duo has already identified a possible suspect, in the form of a flat element snapping into two pieces during the folding and unfolding process.
This takes place close to the middle of the display, where a small support plate comes close to other elements, including an interconnecting cable between the two halves.
Following the blowing up of the screen cracking issue, Apple has made a brief statement acknowledging it is aware, and for users to contact AppleCare for a replacement.
While it is unclear how many devices are affected, it isn't believed to be a widespread problem for Apple.

After speaking to staff members at 20 Genius Bars that AppleInsider trusts, there have only been four impacted iPhone Duo units returned so far as of October 26. Polling will continue after US stores open.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 27 日消息，苹果现已为旗下 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 推出 M6 版本（点此访问），该笔记本主要是更换新款芯片，设计上保持不变，国行售价为 15999 元起，产品将于 10 月 29 日凌晨 1 点 10 分接受预购，11 月 6 日发售。
新款 M6 芯片的 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 继承了上一代外观，可选深空黑色和银色两种配色，配备 3024 x 1964 分辨率 120Hz 显示屏。该机搭载 M6 芯片，为 12 核中央处理器、12 核图形处理器、双 16 核神经网络引擎规格，官方称该机设备端 AI 性能相对于 13 英寸 M1 机型最高提速至 13 倍。
同时，新款 M6 芯片的 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 机型内存带宽达 170GB/s，比 M5 机型的 153GB/s 有所提升，但性能提升并未延伸到基础款的 16GB 统一内存配置。技术规格页面显示，16GB 统一内存的选项仍然限制在 153GB/s。与 M5 机型相同，而只有全新的 24GB 和 32GB 配置才拥有更快的 170GB/s 内存带宽。
作为对比，搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 MacBook Pro 提供 307GB/s 的内存带宽，而搭载 M5 Max 芯片的机型则具有高达 614GB/s 的内存带宽。

units.text: 在苹果预计于当地时间10月28日正式发布新款MacBook Pro之前，业内再次传出有关其硬件设计的重要细节。爆料人士定焦数码在微博发布信息称，即将亮相的触控版MacBook Pro将采用经过改进的全新铰链结构，而这一升级与苹果未来第二代和第三代iPhone Duo折叠屏手机的发展规划存在关联。
根据爆料内容，新款MacBook Pro最重要的升级之一便是铰链设计。虽然具体技术细节尚未披露，但消息称该设计与后续iPhone Duo产品的结构演进有关。不过，目前尚不清楚两者之间究竟共享哪些技术方案，或是否涉及相同的机械结构理念。
这一说法与彭博社记者马克·古尔曼此前披露的信息基本一致。古尔曼曾表示，苹果已经重新设计了触控版MacBook Pro的铰链机构，以确保用户在直接触摸屏幕操作时，显示屏依然能够保持稳定，不会因触控压力而产生明显晃动。与此同时，苹果还调整了散热系统，使空气能够更高效地通过铰链区域流动，从而改善整机散热性能。
古尔曼此前还透露，苹果正在研究配备更大内部显示屏的未来版iPhone Duo。新机展开后的内屏尺寸有望达到约7.9英寸至8.1英寸，相较于现款产品的7.6英寸进一步扩大。不过，Fixed Focus Digital此次提到的铰链改进是否与这一更大尺寸折叠屏设计直接相关，目前尚无进一步信息。
除了铰链升级外，新款MacBook Pro将采用双层OLED显示技术，并伴随明显的售价上涨。古尔曼此前报道称，苹果内部曾讨论将搭载M5 Pro芯片的14英寸MacBook Pro起售价提升至2899美元，而当前对应配置机型的起售价为2499美元。
按照此前多方消息，新一代重新设计的14英寸和16英寸MacBook Pro预计将在当天正式发布。苹果还将在洛杉矶举办名为“Pro and tell”的媒体体验活动，届时新产品的完整规格和售价信息也有望一并揭晓。

units.text: 快科技10月27日消息，今日，苹果正式发布全新iMac，新机搭载M6芯片，起售价12499元，将于10月29日凌晨1点10分开启预购，11月6日正式发售。
全新iMac延续纤薄的一体式设计，提供蓝色、绿色、粉色、黄色、紫色、橙色和银色七款配色，兼顾桌面空间利用与个性化选择。
屏幕方面，新机配备24英寸4.5K视网膜显示屏，分辨率为4480x2520，亮度达到500尼特，支持P3广色域，可显示超过10亿种色彩。
此外，新机还提供纳米纹理玻璃选项，能够减少反光和眩光，适合光线较强的使用环境。
全新iMac搭载苹果M6芯片，最高配备12核CPU和12核GPU，每个GPU核心均内置神经网络加速器，并搭载双16核神经网络引擎，内存带宽最高可达170GB/s。
苹果官方数据显示，与搭载M4芯片的上一代iMac相比，新机在生产力任务中的表现最高提升1.5倍，图形性能最高提升2倍，端侧AI性能最高提升5倍。
AI体验也是此次升级的重要方向，全新iMac预装macOS 27，能够运行本地AI模型，并支持多种针对苹果芯片优化的AI应用。
苹果智能进一步融入系统和应用，可用于信息检索、写作辅助等任务。
不过，苹果智能在中国大陆的推出时间仍取决于监管审批。
新机配备1200万像素Center Stage摄像头，支持人物居中和桌上视角功能，方便用户进行视频会议或展示桌面内容。
音频系统采用六扬声器设计，支持空间音频和杜比全景声，同时配备录音棚级三麦克风阵列。
全新iMac支持Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6，可选配2.5Gb以太网接口，最多提供四个雷雳4端口，并支持外接两台6K显示器。
苹果还对存储性能进行了升级，官方称固态硬盘读写速度最高提升至上一代的2倍。

units.text: Shrinking just aired season 3 earlier this year, but all signs point to a refreshingly quick return, as one of the show’s stars just confirmed season 4 is officially done filming.
Shrinking season 4 has finished filming ahead of expected early 2027 premiere
TV’s streaming era has brought a lot of advantages over linear TV, but undoubtedly one drawback is that shows tend to have much longer waits between seasons.
Traditional broadcast television usually schedules shows to premiere in the fall and run through the spring, then return after a short summer break for a new season in the fall.
In streaming, viewers are shocked when a show comes back after only a year.

Apple TV has slowly been getting better at this. Slow Horses is the best example, but another recent one is Your Friends & Neighbors. And we’re seeing signs of other series getting quicker turnarounds between seasons, including Shrinking.
Shrinking aired its season 3 finale this April, and by May we heard that filming on season 4 was about to start.
Now Jessica Williams, the star who plays Gaby, has confirmed that season 4 has officially wrapped production. This means the series will almost certainly return in early 2027.

On a show like Shrinking, post-production is a much quicker process than with series that are heavy on CGI and other special effects. So we could see Shrinking season 4 premiere in late January, exactly one year after season 3 debuted.
More conservatively, the show returning by spring 2027 seems a safe bet.
You can watch Shrinking seasons 1-3 here on Apple TV.
Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.

units.text: Apple reportedly plans to introduce a low-cost iPhone 18e next spring alongside iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2. Here are the details on what to expect from iPhone 18e, per a new leak.
iPhone 18e will feature A20 chip and possible front camera upgrade, but remain very similar to iPhone 17e per leaker
When Apple introduced new iPhones last month, only three models launched: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, plus iPhone Duo.
Rumors indicate three more new iPhones are coming in early 2027: iPhone 18e, iPhone 18, and iPhone Air 2.
There’s been plenty of reporting on iPhone Air 2 changes, and some on the base iPhone 18, but surprisingly little on the entry-model iPhone 18e.
But today, a new post from Weibo leaker Digital Chat Station outlines what to expect from iPhone 18e early next year. He says it will feature:
60Hz display, meaning no ProMotion still
A20 chip, which doesn’t yet exist in non-Pro form
6.12-inch OLED like its predecessor
48MP single rear camera
Front camera “may be upgraded to 24MP”
Based on these specs, it sounds like iPhone 18e is focused largely on performance improvements.

The A20 chip will be interesting to evaluate, since we haven’t yet seen a non-Pro variant of the latest 2nm technology. Mention of a front camera upgrade is particularly surprising, but my guess is that if it does emerge, it will actually be an 18MP sensor like what’s in other models today.
Other than these two changes, every spec mentioned remains unchanged from iPhone 17e. One detail not addressed is whether the notch will be replaced by a Dynamic Island.
Considering the skyrocketing prices of memory and storage, and Apple’s aims to keep iPhone 18e a budget-friendly model, perhaps the new model will offer fewer upgrades than usual to keep costs down.
What do you think of Apple’s reported plans for iPhone 18e? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: Touchscreen MacBook Pro to Debut Today With These 5 Features

Some reports have suggested the new high-end MacBook Pro models that Apple is expected to announce today might not be called ‌MacBook Pro‌s at all. They could in fact be something altogether new and more exciting – "MacBook Ultra," perhaps – marketed as the company's top-tier laptop offering. The machines are expected to sit above the current M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pros, rather than replace them, suggesting the latter will remain in Apple's lineup.

One thing to state up front is that Apple is expected to stick with the existing M5 Pro and M5 Max chips for its touchscreen MacBook models. Apple reportedly plans to skip what would have been the "M6 Pro" and "M6 Max" for more powerful "M7 Pro" and "M7 Max" chips. Apple announced the new entry-level 14-inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ with the M6 chip yesterday, ahead of pre-orders opening today, but the first "MacBook Ultra" models will use M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, after which second-generation models will come with M7 Pro and Max chips in late 2027.

Apple has already unveiled most of a second set of new products this week, as MacRumors' sources earlier indicated: the OLED iPad mini arrived on Monday, and the M6 iMac and M6 14-inch MacBook Pro followed yesterday. The new touchscreen models are expected to debut today at Apple's "Pro and tell" event in Los Angeles and become available for pre-order at 10:10 a.m. Pacific Time, with Bloomberg reporting that availability could begin as early as November 6. Recent reports have referred to the machines simply as new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models, so the final name remains uncertain.
Below, we've listed the features and changes we are expecting for the new high-end MacBook Pro models.
OLED Display

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman and analyst Ming-Chi Kuo say Apple is readying OLED technology for these models, and industry reports corroborate their claims. Samsung Display is said to be making the panels exclusively, and the supplier has invested heavily in an 8.6-generation OLED production line in South Korea. The line reached a key milestone for mass production in May.

OLED presents an overall upgrade over the current mini-LED display technology, bringing deeper colors and a higher contrast ratio with true blacks. In an OLED display, individual pixels turn off instead of dimming when not activated, so there's less light leakage and better power efficiency. OLED displays also tend to have better HDR output than mini-LED, but they don't always match mini-LED brightness levels.
Touchscreen

The new ‌MacBook Pro‌ is expected to become the first Mac to support touch input directly on the display. It's a notable shift from Apple's longstanding position against bringing touchscreen functionality to the Mac.

Apple previously experimented with touch controls through the OLED Touch Bar on earlier ‌MacBook Pro‌ models, but the feature was ultimately discontinued following a lukewarm reception. Rather than positioning the ‌MacBook Pro‌ as a touch-centric device like the ‌iPad‌, Apple is reportedly planning to let users move seamlessly between touch and traditional trackpad or mouse input across the system.

There are features in ‌macOS Golden Gate‌ that hint at a future touchscreen Mac. Apple added direct touch input to Sidecar so users can tap and interact with macOS elements when using the ‌iPad‌ as a Mac display. macOS Golden Gate‌ also supports an iPhone-style pull-to-refresh option, and it can be used across apps like Safari, Mail, News, Podcasts, and Calendar. A pull-to-refresh option makes the most sense on a touch display.
Reinforced Hinge

Apple has reportedly developed a reinforced hinge and screen hardware to prevent the display from bouncing back or moving when touched. Apple is apparently aware of the same issue that plagues existing touch PCs.
Lighter Design

Gurman has reported that Apple is working to make the OLED MacBook Pro thinner, as part of the company's plan to create "the thinnest and lightest products in their categories across the whole tech industry." (Think the latest iPad Pro and iPad Air – two of the thinnest devices the company has ever made.) Indeed, the reporter said there's a good chance that the next MacBook Pro model will represent a "true overhaul" for the laptop, thanks to the combination of the OLED display and thinner design.
In October 2025, Gurman reported that the OLED MacBook Pro models would have "thinner and lighter" frames. Then again in November 2025, he said the touchscreen models would have "a thinner chassis."

However, Gurman has walked back somewhat on his previous reporting that Apple's upcoming touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro will be thinner than current models. "I don't think it'll be significantly thinner in the end," he said in early October 2026.
In a last-minute detail, Gurman reports that Apple has also reworked the cooling system to improve airflow through the hinge while helping to reduce the laptop's weight.
Dynamic Island

The MacBook Ultra could ditch the current notch used in the MacBook Pro models for a display cutout potentially similar to the iPhone's Dynamic Island, according to Bloomberg. Such a move would mirror Apple's iPhone evolution, since the iPhone's notch became the current Dynamic Island starting with the iPhone 14 Pro models in 2022.

As with the iPhone‌, the Mac ‌Dynamic Island‌ will be interactive and it will contextually expand based on the app or Mac feature in use. The change should address long-standing user complaints about the notch, which physically ingresses into the macOS menu bar.
Price Changes

There is no doubt that Apple will unveil the new MacBook Pro models as ultra-premium products carrying price tags that are higher than the current MacBook Pro 14-inch and 16-inch models. Apple increased the prices of all its Macs in June 2026 – MacBook Pro‌ pricing went up $300 – so the "MacBook Ultra" will likely be even more expensive than expected. ‌

For what it's worth, the higher-end 14-inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ with M5 Pro chip starts at $2,499 after the price increase, while the 16-inch M5 Pro ‌MacBook Pro‌ starts at $2,999. More specifically, Bloomberg reported this week that Apple has discussed charging $2,899 for the new 14-inch model with an M5 Pro chip, which would mean a starting price of at least $3,399 for the 16-inch model. Hold onto your wallets!

Apple tweaked the colors in 2024 to make the back of the ‌iMac‌ a more vibrant shade in those seven colors, but no further changes were made this year. Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman said back in August that "some new color options" would be available for the M6 ‌iMac‌ models, but unfortunately, we're stuck with the colors we've had for years. The new ‌iMac‌ has the M6 chip that was previously added to the Mac mini. It also includes a faster SSD and an N1 networking chip with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. Pricing starts at $1,499.
Pre-orders for the M6 ‌iMac‌ start on October 28 at 10:10 a.m. Pacific Time, and it launches on Friday, November 6.

IT之家注：该系列此前也曾分享过用户因静息心率异常警报而及时就医、确诊并接受癌症治疗的经历。
在最新发布的两段视频中，用户 Morgan 表示，Apple Watch 的高心率警报在夜间将她唤醒。她随后就医，被诊断出肾脏感染，并一度进入败血性休克。
另一名用户 Josh 则称，自己原本体重达 340 磅（约 154 公斤），在 Apple Watch 的活动圆环和运动提醒激励下开始更积极地锻炼，并成功减重。科技媒体 MacRumors 认为这些故事的核心，是强调手表在异常心率提醒、日常活动记录和健康习惯养成中的作用。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，借助 ns2jb 漏洞，Switch 2 之前已终于实现越狱，现在这项破解成果有了最新进展。 IT之家注意到，开发者威尔 · 福斯特（Will Faust）今日在 X 平台发布了一段视频，展示了 Switch 2 独占游戏《马力欧卡丁车世界》在 macOS 上运行的画面。福斯特强调这段录像是真实的，这个项目是 Nxnative 的一个分支版本，专门适配 Switch 2。Nxnative 原本是一款可以在苹果 macOS、iOS 以及 iPadOS 上运行 Switch 游戏的工具。 当然，这款赛车游戏在 macOS 上的运行效果还很粗糙，下方视频就能明显看出来：部分着色器缺失、画面卡顿、模型几何体错乱。但作为可以正常启动运行的《马力欧卡丁车世界》原生 Mac 版本，已经非常令人惊叹。 福斯特称自己拥有《马力欧卡丁车世界》正版游戏，在利用 ns2jb 漏洞之后，从自己的 Switch 2 主机导出了游戏文件。目前还不清楚他是否会继续优化这个移植版本的性能，或是对外公开发布。 这次新发现的 Switch 2 漏洞虽然支持用户导出完整游戏和资源文件，但目前网上流出的完整游戏只有《马力欧卡丁车世界》。网络上还出现了该游戏里碧琪公主的 3D 模型，以及《三角符文》和《黄昏血族》的相关资源数据。 福斯特表示，这个移植项目并非反编译或者重编译，而是把“HOS 系统调用转换为 iOS 系统调用、把 NVN 接口转为 Metal 接口等等”。他说，让《马力欧卡丁车世界》跑起来的大部分基础工作已经由 Nxnative 完成，最难的环节是实现 NVN2 支持。NVN2 是任天堂为 Switch 2 自研的图形应用程序接口。 Nxnative 属于实验性项目，目标是在 ARM 架构设备原生运行任天堂 Switch 游戏，搭载苹果自研芯片的 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad 都在支持范围内。Switch 2 和苹果 Mac 都采用 ARM 处理器，因此不需要做 CPU 指令集模拟。即便如此，任天堂的图形接口以及 Switch 2 的其他底层特性，仍然需要转译才能在 macOS 环境工作。

Nxnative 属于实验性项目，目标是在 ARM 架构设备原生运行任天堂 Switch 游戏，搭载苹果自研芯片的 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad 都在支持范围内。Switch 2 和苹果 Mac 都采用 ARM 处理器，因此不需要做 CPU 指令集模拟。即便如此，任天堂的图形接口以及 Switch 2 的其他底层特性，仍然需要转译才能在 macOS 环境工作。

units.text: Starting today, Opera One users can access a preview feature that lets them tap into local AI models through WebAI, a proposed web standard. Here are the details.
WebAI
Opera announced today that its Opera One browser is the first of its browsers to offer built-in access to local AI models, with Opera GX and Opera Neon to follow.
The feature relies on the WebAI proposed web standard, which allows websites and browser extensions to access AI models running locally on the user’s device.
Here’s Opera:

WebAI is a proposed web standard, backed by companies such as Google and Microsoft, that lets websites and browser extensions use AI hosted through the browser. Opera’s implementation is model-agnostic and built around open models, offering users choice among AI providers. At launch, users can already tap into models from Google and Apple, including Google’s Gemma and, on Macs, Apple’s on-device foundation model, directly in Opera.

The company notes that WebAI can be used to generate text, classify content, and identify relationships between pieces of information, and adds that the feature is opt-in, with no subscription needed, and with users able to control which websites can access local AI models.
Here’s Opera again on some of the potential uses for local AI in the browser:

With local AI built into the browser, both users and developers can benefit from new capabilities. Local AI lets anyone build on top of free, open-weight AI models. Developers can add AI features without running AI infrastructure or paying for every request. Users don’t need AI subscriptions, the information the local AI handles stays on their own device, and they stay in control of the AI on their computer. For example, an extension could sort your tabs, flag clickbait or spot relevant job posts using a model on your laptop, with no account, no fee and no data sent to an AI service.
To help developers (and users) explore what’s possible with WebAI, Opera has released a collection of example extensions that you can find here.
HTML-in-Canvas
Additionally, Opera is launching HTML-in-Canvas today, which, as the company explains, “lets developers put real, interactive web pages inside 2D and 3D scenes.”

The feature allows developers to embed fully functional web pages into 2D and 3D environments, with interactive elements such as menus, buttons, and forms remaining usable even as they move around within a scene. Developers can build these experiences using familiar HTML and CSS.
Here’s Maciej Kocemba, Product Director at Opera GX:

“Honestly, this is a fun one […]. You can take a real web page and throw it into a 3D world, and everything still works: buttons, text, menus, all of it. We wanted users to get their hands on it early and see what they come up with.”

To demonstrate the possibilities, Opera has created two examples: Webpage Bulldozer, which turns elements of a web page into physical objects, and Gamer Room, a virtual 3D room featuring screens that display live web pages. Both demos work in Opera browsers without any additional setup, and you can check them out ⁠here.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，彭博社昨日（10 月 27 日）发布博文，报道称在 14 英寸 OLED 触控屏 MacBook Pro 起售价上，相比较现款 M5 Pro 机型高出 400 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,674 元人民币），苹果公司可能会定价 2,899 美元（现汇率约合 19,376 元人民币），贵出 16.01%。
IT之家注：苹果 M5 Pro 芯片的 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 国行起售价为人民币 19,999 元，对应 24GB 统一内存、1TB 固态硬盘的基础配置。如果按照 16.01% 增幅计算，14 英寸 OLED 触控屏 MacBook Pro 起售价预估为 23,198.8 元。
16 英寸 OLED MacBook Pro 的起售价若同步涨价 400 美元（现汇率约合 2,674 元人民币），起售价可能达到 3,399 美元（现汇率约合 22,718 元人民币）。不过彭博社表示，更大尺寸版本的最终定价或许还会更高。
在发售方面，在新款 OLED MacBook Pro 上市销售后，苹果预计不会直接淘汰现有 Mini LED 屏幕的 MacBook Pro，而是让两类产品并行销售。
彭博社认为对于不需要触控屏的用户而言，仍可选择价格更低的传统机型；愿意为 OLED 显示和触控体验付费的用户，则需承担明显更高的购机成本。
硬件方面，这款新机将首次为 MacBook Pro 配备 OLED 触控屏，但芯片仍沿用现有机型的 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max。除触控功能外，新机还引入了类似 iPhone 的“灵动岛”、更窄的屏幕边框、更轻薄的机身，以及可在触控时保持屏幕稳定的重新设计铰链。苹果还升级了散热系统，以减轻重量并改善铰链处的空气流通。

In the first video, Morgan tells the story of how her Apple Watch woke her up with high heart rate alerts. She ended up having a kidney infection and was going into septic shock. Apple previously shared the story of a woman who was alerted to changes in her resting heart rate. The releases include iOS 26.7.2, iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 18.7.11, iPadOS 18.7.11, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, and tvOS 26.6.1. iOS 18.7.11 and iPadOS 18.7.11 bring the CoreGraphics fix to the iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR, and seventh-generation iPad, all of which cannot run iOS 26. According to Apple, processing a maliciously crafted file on these devices could lead to arbitrary code execution, and the company is "aware of a report that this issue may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack against specific targeted individuals on versions of iOS before iOS 27." For iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, Apple lists security fixes covering 134 vulnerabilities, none of which are flagged as having been exploited in the wild. Apple likewise lists security fixes for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.2. Lastly, tvOS 26.6.1: the only release of these updates with a user-facing change. The update adds support for the fourth-generation Siri Remote on the Apple TV HD and first-generation Apple TV 4K. All of the updates are available now.

units.text: Apple Fixes Possibly Exploited CoreGraphics Flaw on Older iPhones

Among the flurry of iOS 27.2 releases on Monday, Apple also pushed a wave of software updates for its older operating systems, including a fix for a CoreGraphics vulnerability that Apple says may have been exploited in targeted attacks.
The releases include iOS 26.7.2, iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 18.7.11, iPadOS 18.7.11, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, and tvOS 26.6.1.

iOS 18.7.11 and iPadOS 18.7.11 bring the CoreGraphics fix to the iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR, and seventh-generation iPad, all of which cannot run iOS 26. According to Apple, processing a maliciously crafted file on these devices could lead to arbitrary code execution, and the company is "aware of a report that this issue may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack against specific targeted individuals on versions of iOS before iOS 27."
For iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, Apple lists security fixes covering 134 vulnerabilities, none of which are flagged as having been exploited in the wild.
Apple likewise lists security fixes for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.2.
Lastly, tvOS 26.6.1: the only release of these updates with a user-facing change. The update adds support for the fourth-generation Siri Remote on the Apple TV HD and first-generation Apple TV 4K.

All of the updates are available now. On iPhone and iPad, go to Settings ➝ General ➝ Software Update. On Mac, go to System Settings ➝ General ➝ Software Update. On Apple TV, open up Settings and go to System ➝ Software Update.

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple today announced a new 24-inch iMac with the M6 chip for faster performance, an N1 chip with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 support, faster SSD speeds, and more. The new iMac has the same design as the previous model with the M4 chip, and the color options remain the same: blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver. The all-in-one desktop computer still has a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display with up to 500 nits brightness, and a 12-megapixel Center Stage camera with Desk View support. All models continue to have six speakers, three microphones, a 3.5mm headphone jack, and support for Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. First introduced in the Mac mini in August, the M6 chip features the first-ever dual Neural Engine with two 16-core engines, up from one in previous chips. For graphics, the iMac now has Neural Accelerators in each GPU core for the first time. The M6 chip also has up to 170GB/s memory bandwidth, up from 120GB/s for the M4 chip. Geekbench results for the M6 chip already surfaced for the Mac mini, so we know that the new higher-end iMac should offer up to around 40% faster CPU performance compared to the previous model with the M4 chip.

The all-in-one desktop computer still has a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display with up to 500 nits brightness, and a 12-megapixel Center Stage camera with Desk View support.
All models continue to have six speakers, three microphones, a 3.5mm headphone jack, and support for Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.

First introduced in the Mac mini in August, the M6 chip features the first-ever dual Neural Engine with two 16-core engines, up from one in previous chips. For graphics, the iMac now has Neural Accelerators in each GPU core for the first time. The M6 chip also has up to 170GB/s memory bandwidth, up from 120GB/s for the M4 chip.

Geekbench results for the M6 chip already surfaced for the Mac mini, so we know that the new higher-end iMac should offer up to around 40% faster CPU performance compared to the previous model with the M4 chip. Apple says the new model is up to 12× faster than the model with the M1 chip, and up to 18× faster than the final Intel-based iMac.
Apple also says the new iMac has up to 2× faster graphics and up to 5× faster on-device AI performance compared to the previous model.

In the U.S., pricing starts at $1,499 for a lower-end configuration powered by the M6 chip with a 10-core CPU, a 10-core GPU, a dual 16-core Neural Engine, 16GB of RAM, 256GB of storage, and two Thunderbolt 4 ports. The equivalent previous model also started at $1,499 after receiving a price increase in June — it was originally $1,299.
A higher-end configuration for $1,699 bumps the M6 chip up to a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU and has four Thunderbolt 4 ports instead of two.
The maximum storage capacity available is 2TB, while RAM tops out at 32GB.

A power adapter with a faster 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port is a $30 upgrade option for the base model and comes standard on the higher-end model. The previous iMac's power adapter has a Gigabit Ethernet port, aka 1 Gigabit.
With the Apple-designed N1 chip, the iMac now supports faster Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, up from Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 for the previous model.
The jump from the M4 chip to the M6 chip results in the new iMac having up to twice as fast SSD read and write speeds, thanks to PCIe 5.0 support.
The new iMac will be available to pre-order starting Wednesday, October 28 at 10:10 a.m. Pacific Time, and it is set to launch on Friday, November 6.

Apple continues to include a Magic Mouse and Magic Keyboard with Touch ID in the box with the iMac. The accessories did not receive any changes today. Also included: a 143W power adapter, a power cord, and a USB-C charging cable. If you upgrade to a nano‑texture display, Apple includes a polishing cloth in the box as well.

evidence.discovery_lead: 快科技10月28日消息， 彭博社记者马克·古尔曼在苹果Pro and Tell活动前夕释出最后爆料，苹果首款搭载OLED触摸屏的MacBook Pro将于明日正式登场。 这款被寄予厚望的旗舰机型不仅引入了触控交互，起售价更是刷新了纪录，14英寸版本预计从2899美元（约合人民币20658元）起售。 先说定价，新款触摸屏版MacBook Pro将作为产品线中的超高端型号，与现有的非触摸屏版本并行销售。这意味着如果你追求最新的硬件设计，必须支付极高的溢价。 以16英寸机型为例，其起售价预计至少为3399美元（约合人民币24221元），相比四个月前M5 Pro机型的起步价，涨幅高达700美元（约合人民币4988元）。 外观与性能方面，这款新机第一次用上带灵动岛的OLED触控屏，色彩和对比度会提升一大截，搭载M5 Pro、M5 Max芯片。 整个机身则做得更薄更轻，屏幕边框也收窄了，另外苹果还重新调校了转轴阻尼，避免用户点屏幕的时候机身晃来晃去 散热方面也进行了大刀阔斧的改革，新的散热模组重构了气流路径，空气直接通过转轴部位进行交换，这在提升散热效率的同时，也帮助机身实现了进一步减重。 这种设计不仅是为了应付触控操作带来的额外功耗，也是为了维持OLED面板在长时间高亮度下的寿命。 除此之外，古尔曼还曝光了苹果决定给Mac加上触屏的背后故事：据他的消息源透露，库克大约在四年前就拍板立项触屏MacBook Pro，很大一部分原因是用户对这项功能的呼声一直很高。 知情人士表示：“库克当时认为，这件事我们该做了。”

这款被寄予厚望的旗舰机型不仅引入了触控交互，起售价更是刷新了纪录，14英寸版本预计从2899美元（约合人民币20658元）起售。
先说定价，新款触摸屏版MacBook Pro将作为产品线中的超高端型号，与现有的非触摸屏版本并行销售。这意味着如果你追求最新的硬件设计，必须支付极高的溢价。
以16英寸机型为例，其起售价预计至少为3399美元（约合人民币24221元），相比四个月前M5 Pro机型的起步价，涨幅高达700美元（约合人民币4988元）。
外观与性能方面，这款新机第一次用上带灵动岛的OLED触控屏，色彩和对比度会提升一大截，搭载M5 Pro、M5 Max芯片。
整个机身则做得更薄更轻，屏幕边框也收窄了，另外苹果还重新调校了转轴阻尼，避免用户点屏幕的时候机身晃来晃去
散热方面也进行了大刀阔斧的改革，新的散热模组重构了气流路径，空气直接通过转轴部位进行交换，这在提升散热效率的同时，也帮助机身实现了进一步减重。
这种设计不仅是为了应付触控操作带来的额外功耗，也是为了维持OLED面板在长时间高亮度下的寿命。
除此之外，古尔曼还曝光了苹果决定给Mac加上触屏的背后故事：据他的消息源透露，库克大约在四年前就拍板立项触屏MacBook Pro，很大一部分原因是用户对这项功能的呼声一直很高。
知情人士表示：“库克当时认为，这件事我们该做了。”

units.text: 爆料者“数码闲聊站”近日在微博称，苹果计划中的iPhone 18e可能采用6.12英寸LTPS OLED屏幕、A20芯片和单颗4800万像素后置摄像头，屏幕刷新率仍为60Hz。对前置摄像头，爆料者的说法较不确定，称其可能升至2400万像素。
若消息属实，A20芯片和前置摄像头将是这款入门机型较明确的潜在升级方向。苹果今年发布的iPhone 17e配备A19芯片、6.1英寸OLED屏幕、4800万像素后置相机和1200万像素TrueDepth前置相机；因此，传闻中的2400万像素自拍相机将较现款提高一倍。不过，爆料者没有说明相机传感器或镜头是否同步变化。
A20预计将采用2纳米制程，若属实，相比iPhone 17e使用的3纳米A19，可能带来性能和能效提升；这一制程信息来自此前对苹果芯片规划的预测，并非这条爆料明确确认的规格。报道还指出，2400万像素说法存在疑点，爆料者可能混淆了苹果新一代前置相机规格；即使前摄升级，实际成像表现也不能只看像素数。
屏幕方面，消息称iPhone 18e仍会采用LTPS面板和60Hz刷新率，不会加入ProMotion高刷新率。它的6.12英寸屏幕与iPhone 16e、17e的约6.1英寸显示屏接近；后置相机也仍是单摄配置，未见明显硬件升级传闻。更高刷新率面板据称最快要等到2028年的iPhone 19e才可能下放，目前同样只是传闻。
苹果尚未公布iPhone 18e，也未确认上述规格。该机预计于2027年春季与标准版iPhone 18及iPhone Air 2一同推出，具体发布时间仍待苹果正式宣布。

evidence.title: iPhone 18e传闻曝光：升级2nm A20芯片 外观与屏幕或基本不变

units.text: 苹果下一代入门级手机 iPhone 18e 的部分规格近日曝光。根据知名爆料人士 Digital Chat Station 的最新消息，这款预计于2027年春季推出的新机，将搭载全新的A20处理器，但整体设计可能不会偏离现款 iPhone 17e 太远。苹果似乎仍将延续e系列的产品策略，把核心性能升级作为主要卖点，而不是进行大规模外观改造。
按照目前流传的信息，iPhone 18e将采用约6.12英寸OLED显示屏，继续使用LTPS技术，刷新率维持在60Hz。与部分高端iPhone支持的120Hz ProMotion自适应刷新率相比，这一配置显得相对保守。不过，对于定位入门市场的机型而言，维持现有屏幕规格也有助于控制成本，并将更多资源投入处理器等关键组件。
影像系统方面，爆料称iPhone 18e将继续采用单颗4800万像素后置摄像头。虽然目前尚不清楚苹果是否会更换图像传感器或调整镜头设计，但从已披露的信息来看，后置摄像头的硬件架构预计不会出现明显变化。苹果可能继续依靠计算摄影和图像处理算法改善拍摄效果，而不是通过增加摄像头数量来实现升级。
前置摄像头则存在一定变数。Digital Chat Station提到，新机可能配备2400万像素前置摄像头，高于iPhone 17e及iPhone 16e使用的1200万像素前置摄像头。如果这一传闻属实，自拍照片的细节表现以及部分视频通话场景中的画面质量有望得到改善。不过，爆料信息尚不完全明确，也不能排除消息来源将此前有关苹果新一代前置摄像头的传闻与iPhone 18e混淆的可能。
此次最值得关注的升级仍然是A20处理器。按照目前的供应链传闻，A20将采用台积电2纳米制程，相比iPhone 17e搭载的3纳米A19芯片，有望在性能和能效方面取得进步。更先进的制造工艺通常能够在相同功耗下提供更高的性能，或者在维持相近性能的情况下减少能源消耗。不过，实际提升幅度仍取决于芯片设计、频率设定、散热条件以及苹果的功耗管理策略。
如果iPhone 18e确实采用A20芯片，那么它将不只是一次常规的小幅更新。更先进的处理器有望改善复杂应用运行速度、游戏表现和人工智能任务处理能力，同时降低部分工作负载下的能耗。对于需要在手机上运行越来越多人工智能功能的用户而言，芯片性能和内存容量的重要性也在持续提高。
值得注意的是，相关传闻还指出，iPhone 18e可能与标准版iPhone 18采用相同的A20芯片，而不是使用规格更低的处理器。若这一安排最终实现，苹果入门机型与标准机型之间的性能差距可能进一步缩小，产品区分将更多依靠屏幕、摄像头、机身设计和其他功能配置。
内存方面，目前不同消息来源的说法并不完全一致。此前有分析人士预计，iPhone 18和iPhone 18e可能从现款机型的8GB内存升级至9GB，以满足Apple Intelligence等人工智能功能不断增长的需求。不过，最新有关iPhone 18e的爆料没有明确确认内存容量，因此这一规格仍需等待更多信息。
外观方面，iPhone 18e预计不会进行大幅重新设计。此前有关苹果入门机型的消息显示，苹果可能继续保留传统的屏幕刘海，而不是直接采用灵动岛设计。显示屏尺寸和面板技术也可能基本延续上一代产品的方案。这意味着，iPhone 18e的外观变化或许相当有限，主要升级集中在内部硬件。
苹果近年来逐渐将iPhone产品线划分为不同定位：Pro系列强调高端影像、显示技术和性能，标准版则提供相对均衡的配置，而e系列主要面向价格敏感、更加注重日常体验的消费者。对于这类用户而言，处理器升级往往比复杂的外观变化更具实际价值，因为它不仅影响当前应用的运行表现，也关系到未来数年系统更新和新功能的兼容性。
从发布时间来看，iPhone 18e预计将在2027年春季推出，并可能与标准版iPhone 18同期亮相。苹果此前已经调整了部分产品的发布节奏，将高端机型与后续推出的标准机型分开发布。如果这一策略继续实施，2027年春季可能成为苹果集中更新中端及入门级iPhone产品线的重要时间窗口。
当然，目前有关iPhone 18e的所有信息仍属于爆料阶段，苹果尚未正式公布产品规格。屏幕、摄像头、内存和具体发布时间都可能在量产前发生变化。

units.text: Apple is bringing an AI assistant to its suite of productivity apps, including Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. The assistant, which is built on AI models from Apple and OpenAI, can understand a document’s context to perform tasks like designing, animating, and refining slides in Keynote.

In Pages, Apple says the AI assistant can draft, restructure, and tweak written content. It can also calculate, visualize, and organize data in Numbers, while suggesting chart types and building custom tables.

[Image: Apple now lets third-party AI agents plug into its suite of productivity apps. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Apple-Creator-Studio-intelligent-assistant-in-Keynote-on-MacBook-Pro-261027_big.jpg.large_2x.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

Keynote, Pages, and Numbers now support the Model Context Protocol on macOS 27 or later, allowing third-party AI agents to plug into the apps. The AI assistant is rolling out in beta to devices compatible with Apple Intelligence. It works on devices running iOS 27, iPadOS 27, or macOS 27 or later.

Several other updates are coming to Apple’s creative apps as well, with Pixelmator Pro introducing a Generate Fill feature that allows you to edit part of an image by describing the changes you want to see. Apple says the tool “automatically matches the lighting, perspective, and texture of the surrounding environment so edits blend in.”

[Image: Generate Fill in Pixelmator Pro uses AI to carry out changes based on a prompt. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Apple-Creator-Studio-Pixelmator-Pro-Generate-Fill-261027_big.jpg.large_2x.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

Meanwhile, Logic Pro for Mac and iPad is getting a Liquid Glass redesign, along with an AI assistant that Apple says can “set up a vocal track from a single prompt” and edit existing projects. There’s also a redesigned Browser on Mac that uses on-device AI to automatically analyze, classify, and tag added sounds.

Apple is launching an update to Final Cut Pro, too, which brings templates, graphics, titles, and transitions directly into the app through MotionVFX. Apple is also building the Content Hub directly into Final Cut Pro, featuring a library of stock videos, photos, and backgrounds. The updates to Apple’s Creator’s Studio will be available to existing subscribers for free in November.

units.text: Apple is updating the iMac with M6 chips. The new iMac generation was introduced today, giving Apple’s all-in-one desktop computer a performance boost via the same chipset Apple launched with the Mac Mini in August. Prices start from $1,499, and the design otherwise appears largely unchanged. The update was announced ahead of Apple’s “Pro and Tell” event that’s scheduled to take place on Wednesday.

This refresh comes two years after Apple gave the iMac an overhaul with M4 chips, meaning we’re skipping the M5 series entirely on this hardware. That should make this upgrade more meaningful. The M6 is Apple’s first 2nm chip and includes a dual 16-core Neural Engine that can boost performance when running on-device AI tasks. According to Apple’s press release, the M6-powered iMac “delivers up to 5x faster on-device AI performance” compared with the M4 model.

The M6 configurations start from a 10-core CPU and a 10-core GPU for $1,499, which is the same price as the 8-core CPU-equipped M4 iMac. There’s also a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU starting at $1,699. Preorders will launch at 1:10PM ET on October 28th, and it’ll be fully available starting November 6th.

Besides the chip upgrade, the new iMac isn’t getting much in the way of a hardware refresh. It now has Apple’s N1 wireless networking chip, alongside Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 on the base model instead of just the higher-spec variant. It still carries over the same Thunderbolt limitations as the M4 iMac, however — you get only two ports on the 10-core version, and four on the 12-core upgrade.

There are also some new restrictions and fees included in the configuration options. If you want to customize the iMac with a Magic Trackpad instead of a Magic Mouse, it’ll cost you an extra $50, despite this being a free switch on the previous iMac. Ethernet has been upgraded from 1 gigabit to 2.5 gigabit, but that’s now a $30 premium upgrade compared with sticking with a Wi-Fi only configuration. Apple also won’t let you configure the M6 iMac with a Magic Keyboard that has Touch ID but not a numeric keypad — despite showing an image of that on the new iMac announcement page.

[Image: Why show me a non-numpad option keyboard if I can’t actually configure this with it, Apple? https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Apple-iMac-with-M6-color-matched-accessories-261027_big.jpg.large_.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

If you were hoping for some new color options then, hard luck. Apple is offering the exact same color variants as it did with the M4, to the point where it’s just reused some of the marketing imagery and updated them to display more up-to-date content. The M6 chip provides a nice performance boost, but otherwise this is a small spec bump for Apple’s colorful all-in-one.

units.text: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced the new iMac featuring the superfast M6, delivering even more performance and powerful AI capabilities in its strikingly thin all-in-one design. From families and aspiring creators to small businesses, users will experience the speed and power of M6 in everything they do. Featuring a faster CPU and GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core, it blazes through everyday apps and multitasking while delivering powerful performance for creative workflows like photo and video editing. For Intel-based upgraders, the leap is even greater, with up to 18x faster performance than the most popular Intel-based iMac.1 And together with the Dual 16-core Neural Engine, the new iMac delivers up to 5x faster on-device AI performance than M4.1 Whether users are taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS, running local AI models, or vibe coding, iMac is a powerful platform for AI while preserving user privacy.2 Connectivity gets even better with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, along with available 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet and storage that is up to 2x faster, so apps and large projects launch in an instant.3 Completing the iMac experience is an expansive 24-inch 4.5K Retina display; an industry-leading camera, speakers, and mics; up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports; color-matched accessories; and the power of macOS 27. Available in a spectrum of seven colors — blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver — the new iMac is a tremendous upgrade for existing users and an incredible gateway into everything the Mac can do for new users. Customers can pre-order starting tomorrow, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6. “iMac is the world’s best all-in-one, and today it raises the bar yet again,” said Shelly Goldberg, Apple’s vice president of Hardware Engineering. “With the blazing performance and AI capabilities of M6 supercharging every workflow and the next generation of Apple Intelligence with Siri AI — combined with its stunning 24-inch Retina display, its gorgeous design in seven vibrant colors, and macOS 27 — the new iMac has everything users need to run their businesses, manage their lives, and bring their ideas to life.” With M6, iMac brings even more performance, for everything from everyday productivity to creative workloads and AI tasks. iMac with M6 features up to a 12-core CPU — two more cores than before — delivering the world’s fastest single-threaded CPU performance.4 Everything feels extra snappy and responsive for families managing busy calendars, students putting the finishing touches on a project, and small business owners running their companies. An up-to-12-core GPU, also with two more cores than before, now features Neural Accelerators in each core, delivering up to 2x faster graphics for more intensive tasks like photo editing, along with fantastic gaming performance compared to M4.3 Students and creators can now fly through tasks like editing and sharing their latest videos or designing a project for class, all while multitasking with their favorite messaging or entertainment apps. The new Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 2x faster AI compute than the previous generation, and combined with the advanced GPU and faster memory bandwidth and with higher memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, iMac rips through AI tasks like running LLMs on device.3 With all this performance packed into its stunning design, iMac is the perfect all-in-one for a wide range of users and workflows.

With the new iMac with M6, small business owners can work across apps like Bigin by Zoho to effortlessly manage customer relationships, track sales, and streamline everyday workflows, all on its stunning 24-inch 4.5K Retina display.
With the new iMac with M6, students can bring their ideas to life with a spacious canvas to explore, create, and innovate.
With the new iMac with M6, families can effortlessly multitask between everyday apps, from managing calendars and finances to helping with homework, planning vacations, and more.
The new iMac with M6 enables:

Up to 2.5x faster performance in apps like Microsoft Excel, compared to iMac with M1,1 and up to 1.5x faster performance than M4, so families, aspiring creators, and small businesses can fly through daily productivity tasks.3

Up to 3.3x faster graphics performance for tasks including photo editing in Affinity, compared to iMac with M1,1 and up to 2x faster performance than M4, so content creators can edit like never before.3

Up to 12x faster on-device AI performance for prompt processing in LM Studio, compared to iMac with M1, and up to 5x faster performance than M4, so users can run powerful AI models, all while keeping their data private.1
Up to 2x higher gaming performance with ray tracing compared to M4.3

With the powerful performance of M6, iMac lets creators and 3D artists work faster in apps like Blender, from modeling intricate 3D scenes to rendering detailed animations and realizing their creative visions.
The new iMac with M6 makes video editing faster and more seamless in apps like Final Cut Pro, empowering creators to edit high-resolution footage, add stunning effects, and more.

With the new iMac with M6, photographers and creative enthusiasts can perfect their images in apps like Affinity, editing high-resolution photos, retouching fine details, and creating stunning compositions with speed and ease.

Beyond delivering exceptional performance for everyday productivity and creative workflows, iMac is also a powerful platform for AI, enabling users to take advantage of advanced AI capabilities while protecting their privacy. With macOS 27, the next generation of Apple Intelligence is deeply personal, seamlessly integrated across apps, and built with privacy from the ground up. Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI, a new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal, helping users get more done than ever before. On iMac, users can tap into Siri AI to ask questions; find what they need across their messages, emails, photos, and more; and take action across apps. Siri AI is built right into Spotlight, making it easy to search for answers on virtually any topic and ask follow-up questions. With the expansive 24-inch 4.5K Retina display, users can leverage Visual Intelligence with a dedicated keyboard shortcut to ask Siri about anything on their screen, from a chart in a spreadsheet to a photo in a browser tab. Users can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type, and in Mail and Messages, Siri can reflect their typical style and tone.
Siri AI — powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence — allows users to ask questions; find what they need across messages, photos, and more; and take action across apps.

With the powerful AI capabilities of M6, the new iMac lets users do even more with AI-powered apps like Pixelmator Pro and Claude, from enhancing photos and removing unwanted objects to brainstorming ideas, writing, and tackling everyday tasks with speed and ease.

Apple Intelligence also makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notifies them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enables the creation of custom extensions based on a description. In addition, users can easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. iMac also supports a growing ecosystem of AI apps optimized for Apple silicon, including LM Studio Bionic and Topaz Studio, helping users learn faster, think in new ways, and get more done. The new iMac features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, along with 2.5Gb Ethernet that delivers up to 2.5x faster wired connectivity than the previous generation.5 This means faster transfers of large files, smoother streaming of high-resolution content, and even better performance for gaming and demanding business workflows. And with up to 2x faster SSD read and write performance, apps launch quickly, and large files like photo libraries and video projects load in an instant.3 Up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports enable superfast data transfers and make it easy to connect a wide range of accessories, including external storage and docks.6 Users can also connect up to two 6K external displays, creating a vast workspace with more than 50 million pixels to spread out their work. The new iMac is a tremendous upgrade — especially for users coming from an Intel-based iMac, who will experience performance that’s up to 18x faster.1 And with macOS 27, Siri AI and new Apple Intelligence features integrated across apps make AI tasks on iMac more personal and powerful than ever. iMac also includes all of the popular features and capabilities that make it the world’s best all-in-one:

A beautiful canvas for work and play: iMac provides a brilliant canvas for multitasking, immersive movies and games, and more. The stunning 4.5K display delivers crisp, clear details with 500 nits of brightness — offering 5x more resolution and nearly 70 percent greater brightness than the bestselling 24‑inch all‑in‑one PC.7 And P3 wide color brings everything onscreen to life with over 1 billion colors.

Industry-leading camera and audio: A 12MP Center Stage camera helps keep users perfectly framed on video calls, while Desk View enables them to share a top-down view of their workspace — ideal for educators giving lessons or creatives showing off their latest project. iMac also brings incredible audio to any space. Two pairs of force-cancelling woofers with two tweeters fill the room with bold, bass-rich sound, and Spatial Audio with support for Dolby Atmos creates an immersive listening experience. Completing the phenomenal video and audio experience is the studio-quality three-microphone array.
A colorful addition to any space: iMac transforms any space with a spectrum of seven vibrant colors, adding a pop of inspiration to homes, workspaces, and storefronts.

Color-matched accessories and Touch ID: iMac features a color-matched keyboard and mouse or trackpad with USB-C ports, so users can charge all of their favorite devices with just a single cable. Better together with iPhone: iMac brings everything users love from iPhone to a gorgeous, spacious display. The expansive 24-inch Retina display delivers crisp, clear details with 4.5K resolution and 500 nits of brightness.
With a 12MP Center Stage camera, iMac keeps users perfectly framed on video calls, while Desk View helps them share a top-down view of their workspace.
Available in green, yellow, orange, pink, purple, blue, and silver, iMac is a colorful addition to any space — from homes to workspaces to storefronts.

iMac features a color-matched keyboard and mouse or trackpad with USB-C ports, so users can charge their devices with a single cable. And with the advanced security of Touch ID, users can easily and securely unlock their computer, make online purchases with Apple Pay, and download apps.
With Continuity, iMac and iPhone work seamlessly together, making it easy to share files and photos, pick up tasks across devices, and even control iPhone directly from iMac.

The new iMac comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Siri AI and Apple Intelligence, iMac gets even more responsive, reliable, and delightful for everyday use with refinements to design, performance, search, and more. Updates to Liquid Glass deliver a more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined. The new iMac was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 100 percent recycled aluminum in the stand, 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, and 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards. It is manufactured with 40 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new iMac meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based10 and designed to be recycled. Pricing and Availability

Customers can pre-order the new iMac with M6 starting tomorrow, October 28, on apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app in 35 countries and regions, including the U.S. It will begin arriving to customers, and in Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers, starting Friday, November 6.

iMac with M6 featuring a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU starts at $1,499 (U.S.) and $1,449 (U.S.) with education savings. iMac with a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU starts at $1,699 (U.S.) and $1,599 (U.S.) with education savings. Additional technical specifications, configure-to-order options, and information on Magic accessories are available at apple.com/mac.

With Apple Upgrade, eligible customers in the U.S. can lease a new Mac with low monthly payments and easily upgrade at the end of their lease.11 Lease iMac with M6 with Apple Upgrade from $28.99 (U.S.) per month, excluding taxes and any trade-in credit, for 36 months.^

With Apple Trade In, customers can trade in their current computer and get credit toward a new Mac. Customers can visit apple.com/shop/trade-in to see what their device is worth. With year-round education pricing — available to current and newly accepted college students and educators — customers can save on iMac, along with a wide range of products and services through the Apple Store online and in stores. Visit Apple’s Education Store for details. Customers in the U.S. who shop at Apple using Apple Card can pay monthly at 0 percent APR when they choose to check out with Apple Card Monthly Installments,12 and they’ll get 3 percent Daily Cash back — all up front.13 More information — including details on eligibility, exclusions, and Apple Card terms — is available at apple.com/apple-card/monthly-installments.

AppleCare delivers exceptional service and support, with flexible options for Apple users. Customers can choose AppleCare+ to cover their new Mac or, in available markets, AppleCare One to protect multiple products in one simple plan. Both plans include coverage for accidents like drops and spills, battery replacement service, and priority support from Apple Experts. For more information, visit apple.com/applecare.

Every customer who buys directly from Apple gets access to Personal Setup. In these guided online sessions, a Specialist can walk them through setup or focus on features that will help them make the most of their new device. Customers can also learn more about getting started and going further with their new device with a Today at Apple session at their nearest Apple Store.

units.text: M5 vs. M6 MacBook Pro Buyer's Guide: All Differences Compared

Apple today replaced the entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with a new M6 model, bringing more CPU and GPU cores, upgraded wireless connectivity, and more. How much has changed, and is it worth upgrading or choosing the newer model?

The M6 ‌MacBook Pro‌ retains the previous model's design and most of its specifications, concentrating its improvements on processing performance and connectivity. Both models offer 16GB of starting memory, 1TB of starting storage, and up to 24 hours of battery life.

The M5 ‌MacBook Pro‌ originally launched at $1,599 with 512GB of storage. Apple removed that configuration in March, making 1TB standard and increasing the starting price to $1,699. A further price increase in June brought it to $1,999 amid rising memory and storage costs. The M6 replaces that model at the same price.
Here are all of the differences between the entry-level M5 and M6 ‌MacBook Pro‌ models:
14-Inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ (M5, 2025) | 14-Inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ (M6, 2026)
M5 chip made with TSMC's third-generation 3nm process (N3P) | M6 chip made with TSMC's first-generation 2nm process (N2)
FinFET transistors | Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors
10-core CPU | 12-core CPU
4 super cores and 6 efficiency cores | 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores
10-core GPU with a Neural Accelerator in every core | 12-core GPU with a Neural Accelerator in every core
Enhanced shader cores | Updated shader core architecture
Second-generation Dynamic Caching | Third-generation Dynamic Caching
16-core Neural Engine | Dual 16-core Neural Engine, totaling 32 cores
153GB/s memory bandwidth across all memory configurations | 16GB memory: 153GB/s 24GB or 32GB memory: 170GB/s
Bluetooth 5.3 | Bluetooth 6
Broadcom wireless networking chip | Apple N1 wireless networking chip
Thread networking support
Supports two external 4K displays at up to 144Hz each | Supports two external 4K displays at up to 165Hz each
Originally offered with 512GB storage; started with 1TB from March 2026 | Starts with 1TB storage
Originally $1,599; $1,699 from March and $1,999 from June; now discontinued by Apple | Starts at $1,999
Should You Upgrade From the M5 MacBook Pro?

For existing M5 ‌MacBook Pro‌ owners, there is very little reason to upgrade. The M6 is a small refresh aimed primarily at buyers replacing a much older machine, with improvements to performance and connectivity that leave the overall experience essentially unchanged. It offers no increase in memory capacity, additional ports, or longer battery life. If the M5 model already handles your work comfortably, the newer model provides little practical incentive to replace it.

If your current computer can last a little longer, it may also be worth waiting. A redesigned entry-level ‌MacBook Pro‌ with an M7 chip is reportedly planned for as early as the first half of 2027, potentially offering a more substantial upgrade than the M6 refresh.
Should You Buy the M5 or M6 MacBook Pro?

For buyers replacing an Intel-based Mac or an older Apple silicon machine, the M5 and M6 deliver much the same experience. The more consequential improvements come from the hardware they share, so the price and configuration should carry more weight than the chip generation.
M5 vs. M6 Chip Buyer's Guide: How Much Better Really Is M6?

At the same price, memory, storage, and condition, choose the M6. Its newer chip and wireless connectivity are welcome additions, but there is little reason to pay substantially more for them. A discounted M5 model is likely to be the better value for many buyers.

Used and refurbished M5 models offer another potential saving: the 512GB configuration that Apple discontinued in March. If you do not need 1TB of internal storage, this version may provide a more affordable route to essentially the same ‌MacBook Pro‌ experience. The M6 starts at 1TB, leaving no equivalent lower-capacity option.
A well-priced M5 with enough memory and storage for your work is still a sensible purchase, while the M6 is the straightforward choice when comparable models cost close to the same amount.
