units.text: In a roundup of what to expect from tomorrow’s “Pro and Tell” event, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman shared new details about the upcoming OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro models. Here’s what to expect.
Report reveals last-minute details and backstory of rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro
Tomorrow, Apple is expected to announce its first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro models, featuring OLED displays, Dynamic Island, and a thinner, lighter design.
While previous reports have suggested that the new models will come with significantly higher prices, Bloomberg now offers more specific figures, along with additional details about their redesign.

According to Gurman’s sources, “Apple has discussed charging $2,899 for the new 14-inch model with an M5 Pro chip,” which, if Apple applies at least the same $400 premium to the 16-inch model, would mean “the new version will cost at least $3,399.”

Compared to the $2,199 and $2,699 starting prices of the 14-inch and 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro models before Apple’s June price hikes, that would represent an increase of at least $700 in just four months.
Gurman added that “Apple plans to continue selling the non-touch versions alongside the new machines,” and further commented on that in a post on X:
I do not expect the current non-touch MacBook Pros (14 inch at $2499 and 16-inch at $2999) to go anywhere tomorrow. Retail stores are fully stocked up on those as well still. https://t.co/UTs2NJ1N3A
— Mark Gurman (@markgurman) October 27, 2026
In other words, he expects the new OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro models to sit at the top of Apple’s current laptop lineup, rather than replacing the existing M5 Pro and M5 Max models.
However, users looking to get the redesigned hardware will likely have to pay the premium, regardless of whether they actually want a touchscreen.

At $2,899, the 14-inch model would mark the highest starting price for a new MacBook Pro model, surpassing the $2,799 Apple charged for a 17-inch version introduced in 2006. The pricing would also put Apple among the most expensive makers of touch-screen laptops, alongside premium offerings from Dell Technologies Inc. that also feature OLED displays.

Beyond the OLED touchscreen, Gurman reaffirmed that the new MacBook Pro models will feature a slightly thinner design, thinner bezels, a noticeably lighter body, and a redesigned hinge to prevent the screen from moving when touched, all of which we covered earlier today here.
The report also adds a new detail: Apple has reworked the cooling system to improve airflow through the hinge while helping reduce the computers’ weight.
View all comments

Finally, Gurman’s report offers some behind-the-scenes details about how Apple decided to bring touchscreens to the Mac. According to his sources, Tim Cook greenlit the touchscreen MacBook Pro project roughly four years ago, in part because the feature had become one of the most requested by Apple customers.
“He said we should just do it,” according to a person with knowledge of the decision.

Gurman added that Ternus oversaw development of the new MacBook Pro models. According to the report, Ternus believed “Apple had fallen behind in the area and indicated internally that touch screens had become table stakes for laptops, making it time for the company to embrace the technology.”

According to the report, Apple plans to open preorders for the new touchscreen MacBook Pro models tomorrow, October 28, with availability potentially beginning as early as November 6, alongside the new M6-powered Macs announced today.
To read Bloomberg’s full report, follow this link.

units.text: Apple is giving its entry-level MacBook Pro a spec bump. After upgrading the entry-level MacBook Pro with its M5 chip a year ago, Apple is refreshing the laptop today with the M6 chip, which the company launched in August as part of recent upgrades to the new Mac Mini.

Last year’s entry-level MacBook Pro update brought minimal changes from the M4 model that debuted a year prior, including the same design, port layout, webcam, and speakers. The most notable updates, aside from the then-new M5 processor, was faster storage and the option to upgrade its capacity to a hefty 4TB for an extra $1,200.

[Image: Ports on the new M6 version of the 14-inch MacBook Pro include HDMI, MagSafe 3, three Thunderbolt 4 USB-C ports, an SDXC card slot, and a 3.5mm headphone jack. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/apple2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

It’s a similar story for 2026. Announced this morning through a press release, the new 14-inch MacBook Pro features three Thunder 4 USB-C ports that all support charging and DisplayPort connectivity, a MagSafe 3 charging port, full-size HDMI, and an SDXC memory card slot accommodating photographers. It carries forward the same 12MP Center Stage camera and Liquid Retina XDR display with a nano-texture option, but this year the 14-inch MacBook Pro is getting an upgrade to both Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 through the Apple N1 wireless networking chip that was previously only included on MacBook Pro configurations with the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

[Image: Apple says the M6 chip in the MacBook Pro delivers up to “30 percent faster graphics performance” compared to its M5 chip thanks to a 12-core GPU. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/apple3.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

Pricing for the new M6 version of the 14-inch MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 with 16GB of memory, the same as last year’s M5 model. Bumping that to 24GB increases the price to $2,199, while 32GB is $2,399. Included storage starts at 1TB, but increasing that is now more expensive as a result of the current memory shortage. Bumping that to 2TB is an extra $500, while 4TB is now an extra $1,500. Preorders start on October 28th and shipping is expected to begin on November 6th.

The new M6 processor is Apple’s first 2nm chip with a bump to a 12-core CPU, up from 10 cores in the M5, and the company says it offers up to 1.2x faster multithreaded performance when compared to its predecessor. The M6 also features a Dual 16-core Neural Engine to handle heavy on-device AI tasks, plus an upgraded 12-core GPU with a Neural Accelerator in each core. In addition to performance improvements, Apple says its M6 processor is more power efficient.

’Way of the Warrior Kid’ premieres November 25

Earlier this year, during its Apple TV Press Day event, Apple announced “Way of the Warrior Kid,” starring Chris Pratt (Guardians of the Galaxy), Linda Cardellini (Crystal Lake), and Jude Hill (Belfast).

The movie is based on Jocko Willink’s 2017 bestselling novel “Way of the Warrior Kid: From Wimpy to Warrior the Navy SEAL Way.” Willink, a former Navy SEAL himself, also stars in the movie, which is directed by McG (Terminator Salvation).
Here’s Apple’s synopsis of “Way of the Warrior Kid”:

Middle school has been a nightmare for Marc (Hill), a good kid who’s bullied by his classmates and feels like he’s behind in everything, from academics to P.E. to just making friends. That changes when his injured Uncle Jake (Pratt), a decorated Navy SEAL, comes to spend the summer and recuperate with Marc and his mom, Sarah (Cardellini). To help Marc defend himself, Jake devises an ambitious program he calls “Operation Warrior Kid” based on his SEAL training. Instead of teaching his nephew how to fight, Jake shows Marc what real courage is, facing down his own demons along the way.

Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month or as part of the Apple One bundle. It features hit TV shows and movies like Ted Lasso, Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.

evidence.discovery_title: Here’s why the iPhone Duo’s hinge could be cracking the screen
evidence.raw_lead: Apple’s hinge, not the screen itself, may be the problem.
evidence.title: Here’s why the iPhone Duo’s hinge could be cracking the screen

units.text: Within hours of the iPhone Duo launch last Friday, people reported that the inner screen on some brand new foldable phones was already broken. The issue was similar across many photos shared on social media: some kind of issue or crack would appear in the middle of the screen above the hinge, with lines appearing on the right side of the display. On Monday, Apple acknowledged an “issue” and said it’s replacing damaged units, without going into much detail about how many broken phones have been reported so far.
So what’s actually going on?

Shahram Mokhtari, the lead teardown technician at iFixit, has actually taken apart the iPhone Duo and has a pretty good idea about the potential cause, telling The Verge that it’s due to an issue along the hinge, where a series of gears, springs, and joints work together to let the device close flat, while also trying to avoid creating a deeper crease by giving that screen space to bend more gently inside while it’s closed.
[Image: The iPhone Duo’s hinge. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/iPhone-Duo_223b.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

At the troublesome spot, it appears that the flexible inner screen is pushing up against a part of the hinge. That inner screen is already “extremely sensitive,” he says — if you took a pick or a sharp tool and poked at the edges of the screen, “you’re going to break that screen.” If you look at the pictures of damaged Duos on social media, there’s often a black spot where the damage is focused on the display, and that’s where the metal is hitting the screen, Mokhtari says.
[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/iphone-duo-demo-v0-99e59a9by7xh1.jpeg.webp?quality=90&strip=all]

You can see a visual representation of what Mokhtari is talking about in iFixit’s written and video Duo teardowns, which reveal where the hinge transitions, as the center hinge support makes space for a crossing flex cable, creating several edges that could ultimately be the culprit. The damage iFixit has been seeing is at a point where the center support bar might not always drop down far enough while the screen folds, possibly creating a stress “hot spot” between the flat bar and the bent screen inside a closed iPhone Duo.
[Media: https://youtu.be/WOVIjFnivJA?si=-7pDu5QBnjn2IWVK&t=846]

At least one user with a broken Duo screen said they “felt something around the internal hinge” while showing it to a friend, kept opening it, and heard an “audible crack,” with the screen breaking. YouTuber CuriousHagi, who covered a Duo with dirt as part of a strenuous durability test, captured something similar on video, and the screen break appears in a similar spot. In a teardown video, CuriousHagi found that a part of the hinge that connects to the central bar had snapped.
[Media: https://youtu.be/wtP7Q9Io90I?si=xOyzakiNb5gU4Qe1&t=67]

Apple says the issue affects a “small number” of Duo units, and Mokhtari says that “In terms of numbers, we don’t know. Apple definitely has all the data here. And I suspect they know more than they’re telling us as well.” But he notes that because foldable screens are so delicate, a “certain number” of them will fail, as will a number of the hinges because they’re also “extremely complicated and delicate.” And while Apple isn’t recalling the Duos, “If three months from now, we’re still seeing the same kind of failure, then it’s a more widespread problem, and that might lead to a recall,” Mokhtari says.

Mokhtari points out that since this is the first generation of the iPhone Duo, it’s the first time Apple’s engineers are getting data on the hinge, and he says that “I guarantee you” Apple will redesign what’s at fault here for its next-generation foldable. He also notes that, generally speaking, “the phones do seem to be in people’s hands and people are using them, and they’re not running into any issues whatsoever.”
The iPhone Duo’s hinge.

日本市场则受到汇率因素影响，新机价格上涨带来的压力进一步放大，导致市场需求走弱。

units.text: iPhone 18e Could Get Two Key Upgrades While Keeping 60Hz Display
Apple's upcoming iPhone 18e model will retain a 60Hz display but could gain an upgraded front-facing camera, according to the leaker known as "Digital Chat Station."

In a new post on Weibo, the leaker said that the device will feature a 6.12-inch OLED display using low-temperature polycrystalline silicon (LTPS) technology, the A20 chip, and a single 48-megapixel rear camera. They were less definitive about the front-facing camera, saying it could be upgraded to 24 megapixels.

The specifications suggest that the iPhone 18e will offer no major display or rear camera hardware upgrades over the previous two generations. Both the iPhone 16e and iPhone 17e feature approximately 6.1-inch ‌OLED‌ displays with a 60Hz refresh rate and a single 48-megapixel rear camera. The post does not detail the rear camera's sensor or lens, so smaller hardware changes remain possible.

The A20 chip would represent a more significant upgrade. Like the A20 Pro chip in the iPhone 18 Pro, the A20 is expected to use a 2nm manufacturing process, bringing notable performance and power efficiency improvements over the iPhone 17e's 3nm A19 chip. It would also bring the device into line with the upcoming standard iPhone 18, which is expected to use the same chip.

The front-facing camera claim is less clear. Digital Chat Station specified 24 megapixels, although it is unclear whether this refers to a new camera or is a mistaken reference to the 18-megapixel Center Stage camera introduced with the iPhone 17 lineup. A 24-megapixel camera was widely rumored before those devices launched. Either resolution would represent an upgrade over the 12-megapixel front camera used by the iPhone 16e and ‌iPhone 17e‌.

Digital Chat Station previously claimed that the iPhone 18e would retain a 60Hz LTPS display. An earlier report from Korea suggested that an LTPO display capable of supporting 120Hz ProMotion could reach the entry-level iPhone with the "iPhone 19e" in 2028.
The iPhone 18e is expected to launch in spring 2027, alongside the standard ‌iPhone 18‌ and iPhone Air 2.

units.text: Apple to Open Pre-Orders for Five New Products Today
Apple is set to open pre-orders for five new products on Wednesday, including its first yet-to-be-announced touchscreen MacBook Pro models.
Pre-orders will open for the following new products:
iPad mini with OLED display and A20 Pro chip
iMac with M6 chip
14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip
14-inch MacBook Pro with OLED touchscreen
16-inch MacBook Pro with OLED touchscreen

Pre-orders for the iPad mini, iMac, and M6 MacBook Pro open at 10:10 a.m. Pacific Time, with availability beginning Friday, November 6. The iPad mini starts at $699, the iMac at $1,499, and the M6 MacBook Pro at $1,999.

Bloomberg reports that pre-orders for the touchscreen MacBook Pro models will also begin Wednesday following their announcement at Apple's "Pro and tell" event in Los Angeles, with availability potentially as early as November 6. Pricing is expected to start at $2,899 for the 14-inch model and at least $3,399 for the 16-inch.

evidence.title: Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro powered by M6

units.text: Alongside a new M6 iMac, Apple has also unveiled a new 14-inch MacBook Pro powered by M6. The new M6 MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 and will be available to pre-order tomorrow, October 28.
Apple says:

Apple today announced the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6, delivering even more performance, powerful on-device AI capabilities, and faster connectivity for college students, business users, creators, and more. M6 features an advanced 12-core CPU with the world’s fastest CPU core, so everything from productivity tasks to more demanding pro workflows feels incredibly fast and responsive.
In terms of performance, Apple says:
The 12-core GPU is up to 30% faster than M5.
The dual 16-core Neural Engine is up to 1.9x faster than M5.
Up to 13x faster time to first token performance for LLM prompt processing compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
Up to 2.5x faster project build performance when compiling code in Xcode compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5

The new M6 MacBook Pro offers Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity, up from Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 on the previous-generation model. In terms of ports, you get HDMI, MagSafe 3, three Thunderbolt 4 ports, an SD card slot, and a headphone jack. There’s a 12MP Center Stage camera.

Like its predecessor, the new MacBook Pro also offers fast charging support, reaching up to 50 percent charge in just 30 minutes when paired with a compatible higher-wattage USB-C power adapter, such as the 96W Power Adapter.

This is the base model MacBook Pro in Apple’s lineup, replacing the previous model powered by the M5 chip. Apple is also still selling the M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pro models (which rumors say will get a huge upgrade as soon as tomorrow with OLED touchscreens).

The new M6 MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 with 16GB of unified memory and 1TB of storage. It will be available to pre-order tomorrow, October 28, with the first orders arriving on Friday, November 6. It’s available in silver and space black.

units.text: 开发者seedds制作的开源项目nxnative，正尝试让Nintendo Switch游戏原生运行在苹果芯片设备上。实测中，《怪物猎人：崛起》在基础款M1 MacBook Air上稳定达到60帧，无需通过传统模拟器运行。
nxnative要求用户自行提供游戏文件和prod.keys，再将内容转换成可供iPhone、iPad或Mac使用的应用。Switch与苹果芯片均采用Arm64指令集，项目会重写游戏代码，使其能够直接在苹果芯片上执行。
该项目使用小型宿主替代Switch的Horizon OS，并在Metal之上重建Nintendo的NVN图形接口。着色器转换借用了Ryujinx的成果，整体思路则源自曾将《暗黑破坏神II：狱火重生》带到移动设备的d2r-mobile。
YouTube创作者Andrew Tsai使用配备8GB内存、无风扇的基础款M1 MacBook Air进行测试。《圣兽之王》《勇者斗恶龙XI S：寻觅逝去的时光》和《黑暗之魂：重制版》均能运行，但《毁灭战士：永恒》无法启动。
项目README目前列出约70款测试游戏，目标设备多为iPhone 15 Pro或更新机型，以及搭载M1或更新芯片的iPad；Mac应用还需额外构建。nxnative现阶段不支持在线功能和amiibo，各游戏兼容性并不一致，个别成功案例不能代表目录内所有作品都能顺利运行。

evidence.title: iPhone Duo屏幕开裂原因初现端倪：铰链中央支撑杆疑似挤压柔性屏

units.text: 苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 上市仅数小时，就有用户报告内屏出现裂纹、黑斑和异常亮线。随着相关故障照片和视频在社交媒体上不断传播，这一问题开始被外界称为“Crackgate”。最新拆解分析指出，问题可能出在手机内部复杂的铰链结构上：当手机折叠时，铰链中的金属支撑部件可能没有充分收回，从而挤压脆弱的柔性屏幕，在特定位置形成应力集中，最终导致屏幕破裂。
科技媒体 The Verge 于10月27日报道，知名设备拆解与维修机构 iFixit 的首席拆解技术人员沙赫拉姆·莫赫塔里认为，iPhone Duo 的屏幕开裂可能与铰链机构的设计或运作有关。虽然苹果已经承认少量设备存在内屏问题，并表示会为受影响用户更换设备，但公司尚未公布故障数量，也没有正式确认导致屏幕破裂的具体原因。
从用户分享的故障图片来看，受损位置具有一定规律性。部分手机的内屏在靠近中央折叠区域的位置出现黑色斑点，随后伴随明亮的像素线向屏幕右侧延伸。还有用户表示，手机在正常展开时，能够感觉到铰链附近似乎有部件卡住，继续打开手机后便听到了清晰的破裂声，屏幕随即损坏。
这种相对集中的损坏位置，让研究人员开始怀疑问题并非单纯来自柔性屏幕本身，而是与屏幕下方的机械结构存在关联。
iPhone Duo 的铰链并不是一个简单的转轴，而是由齿轮、弹簧、连接件和支撑结构共同组成。它既要让手机折叠后能够紧密闭合，又要为柔性屏幕预留足够的弯曲空间，避免屏幕在折叠处产生过于明显的折痕。为了实现这些目标，铰链内部必须在多个机械部件之间精确协调。
根据 iFixit 的拆解资料，手机中央铰链支撑结构还需要为穿过其中的柔性排线留出空间。这使得相关区域出现了多个边缘和结构交界处，而这些位置可能成为屏幕承受机械压力的薄弱点。
莫赫塔里认为，问题可能集中在铰链中央的一根支撑杆上。按照设计，当手机折叠时，这根支撑杆应当充分向下收回，为弯曲的屏幕腾出空间。但如果某些情况下支撑杆没有完全避开屏幕，金属部件就可能与已经弯曲的柔性显示面板发生接触。
在这种情况下，屏幕并不是受到均匀的压力，而是在很小的区域内承受集中的机械应力。研究人员将其形容为一个应力“热点”。如果这种压力反复出现，或者在某次展开过程中突然增大，就可能造成柔性显示面板内部结构损坏，形成黑斑、亮线甚至明显裂纹。
这一推测也能够解释为什么部分用户报告的故障发生得非常突然。一名用户称，自己在向朋友展示手机时，感觉铰链内部出现了异样，继续展开后便听到屏幕破裂的声音。由于损坏发生在内部折叠区域，即使屏幕外表此前没有明显划痕或撞击痕迹，也不能完全排除内部机械部件造成损伤的可能。
YouTube博主 CuriousHagi 进行的一次耐用性测试，也为这一推测提供了值得关注的线索。他在对 iPhone Duo 进行较为严苛的测试时，拍摄到了屏幕在折叠区域发生破裂的过程。随后拆解手机时，他发现铰链中连接中央支撑杆的一处部件已经断裂。相关损坏位置与其他用户报告的屏幕故障区域存在相似之处。
不过，这些证据目前仍不足以最终确认故障原因。耐用性测试中的手机经历了额外的压力和污染环境，不能直接代表普通用户的日常使用情况；而单个拆解样本也无法证明所有屏幕开裂事件都由同一种机械缺陷引起。苹果仍需要通过对大量故障设备进行检查，才能判断究竟是零部件尺寸偏差、装配问题、铰链运动不顺畅，还是柔性屏幕本身的耐久性不足所致。
苹果目前将问题描述为影响“少量” iPhone Duo 的内屏故障，并建议遇到屏幕问题的用户联系 AppleCare，以获得设备更换服务。公司尚未宣布召回产品，也没有公开说明是否已经确定修复方案。
iFixit 的分析人员指出，折叠屏手机的屏幕和铰链本身就是高度复杂、相对脆弱的组件。柔性屏幕需要在极小空间内反复弯曲，而铰链又包含许多相互配合的机械部件，因此在新产品上市初期出现一定比例的故障，并不完全出乎意料。但如果相同位置的破裂问题在未来几个月持续出现，就可能说明这不是少数个体的偶发故障，而是更广泛的设计或制造问题。
莫赫塔里认为，苹果工程师很可能会根据第一代 iPhone Duo 的实际使用数据，重新评估铰链中存在问题的结构，并在后续机型中进行改进。由于这是苹果首次推出这种形态的折叠屏手机，量产产品在真实使用环境中积累的数据，将帮助公司发现实验室测试中不容易暴露的机械风险。
目前，外界还无法确定故障手机占全部出货量的比例，也无法判断是否需要采取大规模召回措施。苹果没有公布完整的故障统计，社交媒体上的案例虽然能够展示问题的具体表现，却不能据此推断所有 iPhone Duo 都存在相同缺陷。
这场风波也让苹果首款折叠屏手机面临一个关键考验：折叠屏设备的竞争不仅取决于屏幕尺寸、厚度和折痕表现，更取决于铰链与柔性屏幕能否在长期反复使用中保持可靠。如果中央支撑结构确实会在特定状态下挤压屏幕，那么仅仅更换受损设备可能不足以从根本上解决问题，苹果还需要通过设计调整或制造工艺改进，消除潜在的应力集中区域。
在苹果完成进一步调查之前，铰链支撑杆挤压屏幕仍然只是目前较有说服力的技术解释，而不是已经得到苹果官方确认的最终结论。接下来数月故障案例的变化，以及苹果是否调整铰链结构，将成为判断这场“Crackgate”究竟属于早期个别故障，还是涉及更广泛设计缺陷的重要依据。

苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhoneDuo上市仅数小时，就有用户报告内屏出现裂纹、黑斑和异常亮线。随着相关故障照片和视频在社交媒体上不断传播，这一问题开始被外界称为“Crackgate”。最新拆解分析指出，问题可能出在手机内部复杂的铰链结构上：当手机折叠时，铰链中的金属支撑部件可能没有充分收回，从而挤压脆弱的柔性屏幕，在特定位置形成应力集中，最终导致屏幕破裂。 苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 上市仅数小时，就有用户报告内屏出现裂纹、黑斑和异常亮线。随着相关故障照片和视频在社交媒体上不断传播，这一问题开始被外界称为“Crackgate”。最新拆解分析指出，问题可能出在手机内部复杂的铰链结构上：当手机折叠时，铰链中的金属支撑部件可能没有充分收回，从而挤压脆弱的柔性屏幕，在特定位置形成应力集中，最终导致屏幕破裂。 科技媒体 The Verge 于10月27日报道，知名设备拆解与维修机构 iFixit 的首席拆解技术人员沙赫拉姆·莫赫塔里认为，iPhone Duo 的屏幕开裂可能与铰链机构的设计或运作有关。虽然苹果已经承认少量设备存在内屏问题，并表示会为受影响用户更换设备，但公司尚未公布故障数量，也没有正式确认导致屏幕破裂的具体原因。 从用户分享的故障图片来看，受损位置具有一定规律性。部分手机的内屏在靠近中央折叠区域的位置出现黑色斑点，随后伴随明亮的像素线向屏幕右侧延伸。还有用户表示，手机在正常展开时，能够感觉到铰链附近似乎有部件卡住，继续打开手机后便听到了清晰的破裂声，屏幕随即损坏。 iPhone Duo 的铰链并不是一个简单的转轴，而是由齿轮、弹簧、连接件和支撑结构共同组成。它既要让手机折叠后能够紧密闭合，又要为柔性屏幕预留足够的弯曲空间，避免屏幕在折叠处产生过于明显的折痕。为了实现这些目标，铰链内部必须在多个机械部件之间精确协调。
科技媒体 The Verge 于10月27日报道，知名设备拆解与维修机构 iFixit 的首席拆解技术人员沙赫拉姆·莫赫塔里认为，iPhone Duo 的屏幕开裂可能与铰链机构的设计或运作有关。虽然苹果已经承认少量设备存在内屏问题，并表示会为受影响用户更换设备，但公司尚未公布故障数量，也没有正式确认导致屏幕破裂的具体原因。
iFixit 的分析人员指出，折叠屏手机的屏幕和铰链本身就是高度复杂、相对脆弱的组件。柔性屏幕需要在极小空间内反复弯曲，而铰链又包含许多相互配合的机械部件，因此在新产品上市初期出现一定比例的故障，并不完全出乎意料。但如果相同位置的破裂问题在未来几个月持续出现，就可能说明这不是少数个体的偶发故障，而是更广泛的设计或制造问题。
莫赫塔里认为，苹果工程师很可能会根据第一代 iPhone Duo 的实际使用数据，重新评估铰链中存在问题的结构，并在后续机型中进行改进。由于这是苹果首次推出这种形态的折叠屏手机，量产产品在真实使用环境中积累的数据，将帮助公司发现实验室测试中不容易暴露的机械风险。

units.text: Nintendo Switch 2破解公开数日后，多名开发者展示了该平台游戏在任天堂主机以外硬件上的早期运行成果。私人修改工具已让《马里奥赛车：世界》在iPhone 18 Pro上运行，《斯普拉遁：涂击队》也在PC上启动并进入角色选择界面。
Will Faust使用私人修改版nxnative完成了《马里奥赛车：世界》的手机演示。他此前还展示过macOS版本，但当时存在几何体缺失和色彩错误。nxnative会在苹果ARM硬件上直接执行原始Switch程序代码，同时将任天堂图形接口转换为Metal；适配Switch 2还需处理新的NVN2图形接口。
Faust表示，手机演示的实体内存占用不足6.5GB，拥有8GB内存的设备也可能运行。不过，他已经明确表示不会发布相关Switch 2修改代码。
与此同时，Sheepish展示了私人修改版Eden模拟器在PC上启动《斯普拉遁：涂击队》。最初版本无法越过开场动画，后续演示已经进入角色选择，但依然存在严重降速、部分功能尚未实现以及垂直同步失效等问题。
另有片段显示《咚奇刚：蕉力全开》在PC上运行，但相关技术说明较少。这些演示采用不同技术路线，尚不能证明Switch 2游戏已经具备广泛兼容性，也没有公开版本可供独立复现，其中Eden演示仍未达到正常游玩状态。

evidence.title: 为避免在韩国市场引发争议，苹果悄悄移除当地官网 iPad mini（A20 Pro）海报中的手部

units.text: IT之家 10 月 27 日消息，有网友发现，苹果在韩国官网展示的 iPad mini（A20 Pro）宣传海报中去掉了手部，仅保留设备本体。
IT之家注意到，访问苹果中国 iPad mini（A20 Pro）产品详情页时，可以看到第二页展示一只手捏住平板电脑的画面，以此突出新款 iPad mini 的 5.4mm 纤薄机身。不过，韩国官网对应宣传海报却没有出现手部。
事实上，在韩国市场，用食指和拇指比出类似「C」的手势具有冒犯意味的动作，极易引发舆论风波。曾经《冒险岛》就因宣传动画中出现疑似相关手势而陷入争议，导致开发商 Nexon 最终不得不出面道歉。而苹果在 iPhone Air 时期就在官网进行了类似的差异性海报设计。
苹果宣传图中，手指捏住 iPad 的姿势恰好与上述争议手势存在一定相似之处。尽管多数人可能认为，两者显然属于不同情境，原本并无关联，但在容易引发争议的舆论环境下，仍可能有人对此作出不同解读。

units.text: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro reportedly carries a $400 premium, with a starting price of $2,899.

Apple is expected to introduce 14-inch and 16-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro models on Wednesday as premium additions to the lineup. The existing non-touchscreen models will remain available alongside them.

According to Bloomberg's sources, Apple mulled over a $2,899 starting price for the 14-inch model with an M5 Pro chip. That would make it $400 more expensive than the current 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro.
The current 16-inch MacBook Pro starts at $2,999 without a touchscreen. A matching $400 increase would situate the new model at $3,399.

At $2,899, the 14-inch model would have the highest starting price of any new MacBook Pro. That comes in at $700 more than the 14-inch and 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro models before Apple's mid-year price hikes.

The new touchscreen MacBooks will feature OLED XDR displays and a Dynamic Island, while retaining the current lineup's general appearance. They'll also have thinner display borders, slightly slimmer bodies, and weigh less.
Apple has also redesigned the hinge to keep the screen steady during touch input. The cooling system has been redesigned, reducing weight and improving airflow through the hinge.
The company has updated macOS Golden Gate to support touch, including dial-like menus that appear around a user's finger. The keyboard and trackpad will remain the primary input methods.

Apple plans to begin taking preorders on Wednesday, with sales potentially starting on November 6. That would match the release date for the updated iPad mini, M6 MacBook Pro, and M6 iMac announced earlier this week.

The first touchscreen MacBook Pros will likely feature the M5 Pro and M5 Max processors, skipping the M6 chip. Bloomberg says that Apple is also developing M7 Pro and M7 Max versions for the fall of 2027.

The M6 chip in the ‌MacBook Pro‌ features a 12-core CPU with 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores, paired with a 12-core GPU. This is up from the M5 chip with a 10-core CPU with 4 super cores and 6 efficiency cores, paired with a 10-core GPU. M6 features an advanced 12-core CPU with the world's fastest CPU core, so everything from productivity tasks to more demanding pro workflows feels incredibly fast and responsive. The 12-core GPU delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics and up to 25 percent faster AI workloads when compared to M5, making the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 a compelling value for users who need serious power. The Neural Engine doubles from 16-cores to a dual 16-core Neural Engine system with 32 total cores. Memory bandwidth also increases from 153GB/s to 170GB/s, but only on models with 24GB and 32GB of memory. units.text: Apple Announces New 14-Inch MacBook Pro With M6 Chip
Apple today announced a refreshed 14-inch MacBook Pro featuring the M6 chip, upgraded connectivity specifications, and more.
The new 14” MacBook Pro with M6Apple
Watch on YouTube

The M6 chip in the ‌MacBook Pro‌ features a 12-core CPU with 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores, paired with a 12-core GPU. This is up from the M5 chip with a 10-core CPU with 4 super cores and 6 efficiency cores, paired with a 10-core GPU.

M6 features an advanced 12-core CPU with the world's fastest CPU core, so everything from productivity tasks to more demanding pro workflows feels incredibly fast and responsive. The 12-core GPU delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics and up to 25 percent faster AI workloads when compared to M5, making the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 a compelling value for users who need serious power.

The Neural Engine doubles from 16-cores to a dual 16-core Neural Engine system with 32 total cores. Memory bandwidth also increases from 153GB/s to 170GB/s, but only on models with 24GB and 32GB of memory.

With additional Neural Accelerators in the GPU and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, M6 turns MacBook Pro into an even more powerful platform for AI — from taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS to running LLMs locally, all while preserving user privacy.

Alongside the M6 chip, the new 14-inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ now features support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity via Apple's N1 wireless chip. It can also now drive dual external 4K displays at up to 165Hz, up from 144Hz.
The 14-inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ continues to start with 1TB of storage. The previous model's 512GB configuration was dropped in March.

Everything else remains the same as the previous model with the M5 chip. The new 14-inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ is available for pre-order starting tomorrow (Wednesday, October 28). It launches on Friday, November 6. It starts at $1,999.

units.text: A new claim from a generally reliable leaker details most of the specifications for the forthcoming iPhone 18e, with the only significant upgrade being the processor.
Leaker Digital Chat Station has been posting and sometimes reposting about the display for the iPhone 20 Pro, but now claims to have details for the iPhone 18e.
Writing on the Chinese social media site Weibo, the leaker says that the iPhone 18e will have:
6.12-inch 60Hz LTPS OLED screen
A20 processor
One 48 megapixel rear camera
Possibly a 24 megapixel selfie camera

That would mean the iPhone 18e retaining the same display as its two predecessors. Apple describes both the iPhone 16e and iPhone 17e as having 6.1-inch displays, so 6.12-inches is likely a rounding error at most.

Unsurprisingly, the screen will not add the ProMotion feature that distinguishes the more expensive iPhone models. This both speeds up and slows down the display, making it responsive when needed but also saving battery life when it can.

So on the surface the iPhone 18e is not expected to be materially different from the previous models, but it will see a big improvement in use because of its processor. Instead of the A19 of the iPhone 17e, or the A18 of the iPhone 16e, the leaker is certain the new model will use the A20 processor.
This is not the same A20 Pro processor as used in the iPhone 18 Pro, but it is believed to be another 2-nanometer chip. That should bring it extra performance, but also greater power efficiency.

The iPhone 18e is expected to be launched in spring 2027 alongside the forthcoming iPhone 18. This base model is also expected to use the A20 processor, and some previous rumors claim that it and the iPhone 18e will be much more alike than the iPhone 17 and the iPhone 17e.

units.text: Apple has scored another win in its trade secrets misappropriation lawsuit against two former employees, OpenAI, and io Products. Here are the details.
A bit of context

Earlier this month, Judge Edward Davila granted some of Apple’s requests for expedited discovery in the lawsuit where the company accuses two former employees (Chang Liu and Tang Tan), as well as OpenAI and io Products, of trade secret misappropriation.

As we’ve been covering since July, Apple filed this lawsuit accusing the defendants of improperly accessing or using confidential information about its products and technologies to help advance OpenAI’s consumer hardware development efforts.

As part of the lawsuit, Apple asked Judge Davila to issue a preliminary injunction (aimed at preventing the defendants from further using its alleged trade secrets), as well as expedited discovery to obtain early access to internal documents, forensic evidence, and employee testimony.
In his decision partially granting Apple’s request for expedited discovery, Judge Davila gave the company early access to select internal documents, forensic evidence, and employee testimony.
However, he postponed ruling on several other requests, finding Apple’s definition of “Apple Originated Information” too broad.
Following the decision, Apple and the defendants agreed on a narrower definition of the term, which Judge Davila has now adopted (with modifications), allowing Apple to pursue additional discovery.
Today’s decision

In his new decision, Judge Davila granted several of Apple’s previously deferred requests, expanding the company’s access to records concerning its former employees’ handling of confidential information, their use of AI tools, and OpenAI’s recruitment and hardware development practices.
That includes:
Records of Liu’s use of ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, OpenClaw, and other AI tools, including on personal and corporate devices and accounts.
Details about devices, accounts, and messaging apps Liu and Tan allegedly used to access, store, or share confidential Apple information.
Details about any confidential Apple information that may have been deleted or destroyed, including when, how, why, and by whom
Testimony from OpenAI and io Products representatives about work involving Apple information related to batteries, power management, and metal finishing.
Testimony about OpenAI’s interviews involving Apple employees, including whether confidential Apple information was discussed or solicited.
Testimony about steps OpenAI took (or failed to take) to prevent unauthorized use or disclosure of Apple information.
That said, he also denied Apple’s requests for details about OpenAI’s own devices and accounts, its internal investigations, and any potential deletion of confidential Apple information.

He also denied two additional requests for corporate testimony, finding that they were “too broad at this stage and better suited for merits discovery,” meaning Apple can pursue them through the regular discovery process.
Under the new order, the defendants have up to 14 days to produce the requested records and respond to Apple’s questions.

Records of Liu’s use of ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, OpenClaw, and other AI tools, including on personal and corporate devices and accounts.
Details about devices, accounts, and messaging apps Liu and Tan allegedly used to access, store, or share confidential Apple information.
Details about any confidential Apple information that may have been deleted or destroyed, including when, how, why, and by whom
Testimony from OpenAI and io Products representatives about work involving Apple information related to batteries, power management, and metal finishing.
Testimony about OpenAI’s interviews involving Apple employees, including whether confidential Apple information was discussed or solicited.
Testimony about steps OpenAI took (or failed to take) to prevent unauthorized use or disclosure of Apple information.
Under the new order, the defendants have up to 14 days to produce the requested records and respond to Apple’s questions.

units.text: 苹果于10月27日正式向iPhone和iPad用户推送iOS 27.2系统更新。此次更新重点扩展了Siri AI的语言支持范围，增强了记忆能力，同时为信息、FaceTime、播客以及折叠屏iPhone Duo等产品带来一系列新功能，并包含超过160项安全修复。
根据苹果公布的信息，Siri AI现已新增法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语测试版支持。升级后，Siri AI能够记住用户此前对话中的内容，并结合历史信息进行回复。近年来，能够记忆用户偏好和过往交流内容已成为人工智能助手发展的重要方向。
除了自身生成建议和回答外，Siri AI如今还可以调用更多信息来源，包括“信息”应用中的照片附件、日历活动参与者信息、语音留言内容、Safari浏览历史记录以及阅读列表等。苹果同时允许用户自行指定哪些应用的数据不应被纳入Siri AI的记忆范围。
尽管折叠屏手机iPhone Duo近期因部分用户反馈屏幕问题而受到关注，但苹果依然通过本次更新为该设备增加了多项功能。iOS 27.2首次为iPhone Duo提供Apple Pencil支持，可在备忘录和Preview等应用中配合触控笔使用。此外，系统还新增Edge Light功能，使用户在视频通话时能够更好地突出面部显示效果。
FaceTime也迎来重要升级。新版系统加入Dual Capture双重拍摄功能，允许用户在群组通话过程中同时通过前置和后置摄像头进行画面直播。同时，用户还能够在通话中邀请第三方手语翻译人员或实时字幕服务提供者加入。
在“信息”应用方面，iOS 27.2能够智能识别消息内容，并建议用户将相关信息转换为提醒事项或日历事件。共享相册功能也得到增强，用户现在可以修改图片说明文字、添加评论，并查看共享相册的到期时间提醒。
播客应用则进行了界面与内容推荐优化，将更加突出用户已关注节目的最新节目内容，同时显示当前正在收听的剧集。
体育赛事观看体验同样获得提升。苹果将此前在Apple TV上的Multiview多画面观看功能引入iPhone设备。美国用户可同时观看最多四路体育赛事直播，包括美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）、一级方程式赛车（F1）以及美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）“Friday Night Baseball”双赛直播等内容。观看F1比赛时，用户还能够同时查看多个赛事视角画面。
安全更新方面，苹果表示iOS 27.2包含超过160项安全漏洞修复。与此同时，许多修复内容也被移植回旧版本系统，以便仍在使用iOS 26的用户同样获得安全保护。苹果数据显示，目前大约80%的iPhone用户仍运行iOS 26系统。
此外，苹果还为最早于2024年发布的iOS 18推送了一项特殊安全补丁。苹果表示，该漏洞可能曾被用于针对特定目标用户发动“极其复杂的攻击”，影响范围涉及iOS 27发布之前的系统版本。不过苹果并未披露攻击者身份或相关技术细节。业界通常认为，苹果使用此类表述时，往往意味着漏洞可能已被政府级间谍软件或执法取证工具利用。
随着iOS 27.2的发布，苹果进一步强化了其人工智能能力、多任务应用体验以及系统安全防护水平，并持续将部分关键安全更新覆盖至较旧版本设备。

units.text: 据彭博社报道，苹果公司在本月成功断定消费者愿意为折叠屏iPhone支付2000美元甚至更高价格。现在，它正准备通过另一款昂贵新品考验消费者的购买意愿：触摸屏笔记本电脑。
当前16英寸MacBook Pro
苹果计划在周三举行的“Pro and Tell”发布会上推出新款14英寸和16英寸高端MacBook Pro，在现有产品阵容之上增加价格更高的机型。新设备将配备所谓的OLED XDR触摸显示屏和灵动岛设计，这两项功能都将首次登陆Mac，同时也将把产品起售价推至新高。
据一位知情人士透露，苹果已讨论将搭载M5 Pro芯片的新款14英寸MacBook Pro定价为2899美元，比今年3月推出、随后于6月涨价的现款M5 Pro机型高出400美元。
现有不带触屏的16英寸MacBook Pro起售价为2999美元，这意味着新版本至少将定价3399美元。理论上，较大尺寸机型的价格溢价可能比小尺寸机型更高。苹果计划在新机型上市的同时继续销售非触屏版本。
如果定价为2899美元，这款14英寸机型将创下新款MacBook Pro的最高起售价纪录，超过苹果2006年推出的17英寸机型2799美元的起售价。这一定价也将使苹果跻身触摸屏笔记本电脑价格最高的厂商之列，与戴尔旗下同样配备OLED显示屏的高端产品处于同一价位区间。
在洛杉矶举行的发布会上，苹果将直接面向内容创作者、网红和媒体编辑专业人士推广新笔记本。苹果认为，这些群体构成了新款MacBook Pro目标受众的主体。
截至发稿，苹果发言人不予置评。

units.text: iOS 27.2 is now available to everyone after six weeks of beta testing. The update was released on Monday, bringing multiple new iPhone features. Here’s everything you need to know.
Why iOS 27.2 and not iOS 27.1?
Apple released iOS 27 on September 14, bringing a ton of new iPhone features, including Siri AI. iOS 27.2 entered beta testing just two days later on September 16.

What happened to iOS 27.1? iOS 27.1 was exclusive to the iPhone Duo, which was released last week and shipped with iOS 27.1. With iOS 27.2, the software update paths have converged and all iPhones will be on the same page going forward.
iOS 27.2 new features
New Siri AI features
Siri AI was the big new feature in iOS 27, and iOS 27.2 expands the feature in multiple ways. First, Siri AI is now available in these five languages:
French
Japanese
Korean
Portuguese
Spanish
Second, iOS 27.2 also adds several new features to Siri AI. From Apple’s release notes:
Siri AI can recall your past conversations, so you can ask Siri about something it told you before, like the restaurants it recommended last week

Siri AI can draw from more sources to give you a great answer, including photos attached in Messages, Calendar event attendees, your voicemails, and better results from Safari history and Reading List
Excluded Apps lets you choose which apps Siri, Search, and suggestions can access, all from one setting
Granular text selection lets you select and copy just the part of a Siri response you need
Dual Capture mode for Group FaceTime

In iOS 27, Apple added a new Dual Capture feature for FaceTime that lets you have your front and rear cameras active at the same time. The person on the other end of the call will see you as well as whatever you’re looking at. iOS 27.2 expands this feature to Group FaceTime calls for the first time.
Dual Capture requires an iPhone 17 or later, and everyone on the call needs to be running iOS 27.
Also in iOS 27.2, FaceTime now supports adding a third party sign language interpreter or live captioner to a call.
Apple Podcasts

In Apple Podcasts, the “Up Next” queue has been refreshed with two new dedicated rows: New Episodes and Continue Playing. The New Episodes list shows the latest episodes from shows you follow, while Continue Playing shows in-progress episodes, organized by most recently played.
Additionally, episode lists also now use color-matched backgrounds based on the podcast art.
TV app changes

There are two changes to the TV app included in iOS 27.2. First, the update adds Multiview support to iPhone for the first time. This lets you watch up to four live sports streams simultaneously, including MLS, F1, and MLB.
The Apple TV app in iOS 27.2 adds support for profiles for the first time. This feature has been available on tvOS for several years, but this is the first time it has come to iPhone.
Read more: iOS 27.2 gives Apple TV a new profiles feature on iPhone
Suggestions in Messages

Suggestions in Messages, which feature Apple tested in iOS 27 but removed before the update was released, have returned in iOS 27.2. This feature adds quick shortcut buttons to Messages, making it easy to add things to apps like Calendar and Reminders with a single tap.
Apple Music rebrand

iOS 27.2 introduces a new brand identity for Apple Music. This includes a new app icon, seen above. There are also various interface tweaks throughout the Music app. For example, the red interface accents are now blue.
This is part of a larger Apple Music rebrand that the company debuted last week.
iPhone Duo features
iOS 27.2 adds two new features for iPhone Duo:
Support for Apple Pencil (USB-C)
Edge Light: add a ring light around the edge of your display to illuminate your face during calls.
More tidbits
Support for SynthID watermarking to help identify whether an image was generated or modified with generative tools in Photos and Image Playground.
Shared Albums in Photos adds the ability to edit captions and comments. They can also display a reminder before albums expire so participants can save important photos and videos.
The Friends tab in the Games app provides context on friend suggestions and shows recent games played on friends’ player pages.
There are small interface tweaks to the Clock app, including smaller a.m. and p.m. labels.
iOS 27’s Call Context feature, which surfaces information right on your screen when calling a business, has been expanded to include anniversaries.
Security fixes
iOS 27.2 also includes a ton of security fixes, as Apple outlines on its website. There are security fixes in apps like Mail and Safari, as well as Apple Intelligence, the Neural Engine, and more.
Wrap up
Have you updated to iOS 27.2 yet? What new features stand out most to you? Let us know down in the comments.

units.text: Today Apple unveiled a new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip. It has the same design as before and many of the same features, so what’s actually changed? Here’s what’s new.
#1: M6 chip
Here’s a quick rundown of how the M6 chip compares to last year’s M5, per Apple:
M6 chip
12-core CPU with 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores
12-core GPU
Dual 16-core Neural Engine
Up to 170GB/s memory bandwidth
M5 chip
10-core CPU with 4 super cores and 6 efficiency cores
10-core GPU
16-core Neural Engine
153GB/s memory bandwidth
In real-world use, here are the gains Apple says to expect: “The 12-core GPU delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics and up to 25 percent faster AI workloads when compared to M5.”
Finally, here are some pro workflow examples that compare the M6 MacBook Pro to the M5:
Up to 1.3x faster time to first token performance for LLM prompt processing
Up to 1.3x faster render performance with ray tracing in Blender
Up to 1.2x faster image-processing performance in Affinity
Up to 1.3x faster project build performance when compiling code in Xcode
#2: N1 wireless chip
Apple’s N1 wireless chip that first debuted in the iPhone 17 is now included in the MacBook Pro too.
N1 gives the new MacBook Pro two main upgrades:
Wi-Fi 7 support, up from Wi-Fi 6E
Bluetooth 6, up from Bluetooth 5.3
Apple also says that N1 improves the performance and reliability of certain features such as AirDrop and Personal Hotspot.
M6 MacBook Pro vs M5 model: wrap-up
Surprisingly, that’s the end of the list for M6 MacBook Pro upgrades. The new model is solely a spec bump update, with two new chips and no other listed changes.
That said, the M6 MacBook Pro is still a fantastic computer for anyone who wants Apple’s latest chip with a great Liquid Retina XDR display and excellent battery life.
But if you’re interested in something more radically new, Apple’s redesigned MacBook Pro with high-end chips is expected to be unveiled tomorrow.
Are you buying an M6 MacBook Pro? Why or why not? Let us know in the comments.
*Buy Mac with 15% discount from Apple refurbished

units.text: Apple’s YouTube channel shared two new videos today from its “True Apple Watch Story” series, highlighting how the device helped save one woman’s life and transform another person’s fitness journey. Watch them below.
Morgan’s close call and Josh’s fitness journey

While Apple has long promoted the Apple Watch as a health and fitness device, the company has been increasingly turning to real-life stories to illustrate how its features can make a difference in people’s lives.

What started as rather light-hearted “Dear Apple” event segments featuring people thanking Tim Cook and the company for the Apple Watch has evolved into dedicated campaigns highlighting real-life experiences, including a recent campaign in China focused on the device’s health and safety features.
Today, Apple published two new videos. The first features Josh, a user who weighed about 340 pounds before turning to the Apple Watch’s Activity Rings to help improve his fitness.
The second features Morgan, who credits the device’s high heart rate notifications with helping save her life after doctors diagnosed her with a kidney infection that had progressed to septic shock.
Today’s videos join other True Apple Watch Story videos, including Connor’s Heart Health Emergency and Amanda’s Rare Cancer Diagnosis, and you can watch them all on Apple’s YouTube channel.
You can also read about my own run-in with the Apple Watch’s atrial fibrillation alert here.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，消息源 @itspdfu 昨日（10 月 27 日）在 X 平台发布推文，通过挖掘 macOS 27.2 Beta 4 更新，在代码中发现了更多服务触控 MacBook Pro 的线索和证据。
IT之家此前报道，在 Safari 中，用户拖动标签页后，标签会“抬起”并放大，随后随手指移动到新位置；长按标签则可调出上下文菜单。与鼠标或触控板操作不同，这套交互明显更贴近 iPhone、iPad 的触控逻辑。
在 Finder 应用中，苹果为“编辑标签”菜单也扩大了选项间距，让小尺寸控件更容易被指尖准确点选。
在日历应用中，日程事件新增了触控专用的圆形缩放手柄，用户可以直接用手指调整事件时长或范围，而不必依赖精确的鼠标指针。
此外，macOS 27 为触控式 Mac 和带有全新 MenuBarAgent 的动态岛铺平了道路，一些系统精简版和极简版视图已经发布。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 27 日消息，苹果今天推送了 iOS 27.2 正式版，为旗下首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 带来了 Apple Pencil 手写笔支持，目前苹果已发布文档，对相应文档进行介绍。
苹果表示，iPhone Duo 仅可搭配单独销售的 Apple Pencil (USB-C) 使用。其他 Apple Pencil 型号不兼容 iPhone Duo，用户需要使用 USB-C 充电线连接 iPhone Duo 以配对设备：
配对 Apple Pencil：轻点“轻点以连接”。配对 Apple Pencil 后，你可以将它与 USB-C 充电线断开连接。Apple Pencil 会保持配对状态，直至你重启 iPhone Duo、关闭蓝牙或者将 Apple Pencil 与其他设备配对。若要再次使用，请重复这些步骤进行配对。
为 Apple Pencil 充电：Apple Pencil 会在插入 iPhone Duo 时充电。
苹果表示，用户可以在“备忘录”、“无边记”和提供“标记”功能的其他 App（如“照片”）中用 Apple Pencil 绘制。绘制或速绘时，倾斜 Apple Pencil 可添加阴影或更改线条粗细（具体取决于绘图工具）。
此外，用户可以在系统“电池”小组件查询 Apple Pencil 电量，并在设置“Apple Pencil”选项卡中管理 Apple Pencil。
IT之家注意到，此前有消息称苹果实际上为 iPhone Duo 打造了一把专属短款 Apple Pencil，相应产品支持吸附在 iPhone Duo 上，但苹果最终砍掉了这款产品。

units.text: 苹果于10月27日正式发布新一代24英寸iMac。新机搭载全新的M6芯片，并引入支持Wi‑Fi 7和Bluetooth 6的N1芯片，同时提升了SSD存储性能，在保持原有外观设计的基础上进一步增强整体性能。
新款iMac延续了上一代M4版本的设计语言，继续提供蓝色、绿色、粉色、黄色、紫色、橙色和银色七种配色。设备配备24英寸4.5K Retina显示屏，同时保留支持Center Stage人物居中和Desk View桌面视图功能的1200万像素摄像头。
苹果此前已在今年8月发布的Mac mini中首次引入M6芯片。该芯片最大的变化之一是首次采用双神经网络引擎设计，由两个16核心Neural Engine组成，而此前苹果芯片仅配备单个神经网络引擎。在图形处理方面，M6首次在每个GPU核心中加入Neural Accelerators神经加速单元。此外，M6的统一内存带宽最高达到170GB/s，高于M4芯片的120GB/s。
在美国市场，新款iMac起售价为1499美元。基础配置搭载拥有10核心CPU、10核心GPU以及双16核心Neural Engine的M6芯片，配备16GB统一内存、256GB存储空间和两个Thunderbolt 4接口。苹果指出，与之对应的上一代机型在今年6月调价后同样为1499美元，而最初上市价格为1299美元。
售价1699美元的高配版本则升级为12核心CPU和12核心GPU，同时配备四个Thunderbolt 4接口，而非基础版的两个接口。
在存储和内存方面，新款iMac最高可选配2TB固态硬盘和32GB统一内存。
网络连接方面，新机采用苹果自研N1芯片，支持Wi‑Fi 7和Bluetooth 6，相比上一代支持的Wi‑Fi 6E和Bluetooth 5.3进一步升级。
基础版机型可额外支付30美元升级配备2.5Gb以太网接口的电源适配器，高配版则默认提供这一配置。相比之下，上一代iMac所配备的电源适配器仅提供1Gb以太网接口。
得益于对PCIe 5.0标准的支持，新款iMac的SSD读写速度相比M4版本最高可提升至两倍，从而进一步增强系统响应速度和文件传输性能。
苹果表示，新款iMac将于10月28日开始接受预订，并计划于11月6日正式发售。

evidence.discovery_title: iPhone Duo: Lock Screen Rotation for One or Both Displays
evidence.raw_lead: On iPhone Duo, you can lock the screen orientation of its two displays independently. In other words, the outer display can stay locked in portrait, while the inner display remains free to rotate as you open and reposition the phone. For example, you could keep the outer display locked in portrait for reading while reclining on the sofa, but leave the inner display free to rotate into landscape for watching videos, without having to toggle Orientation Lock each time.
evidence.title: iPhone Duo: Lock Screen Rotation for One or Both Displays

units.text: On iPhone Duo, you can lock the screen orientation of its two displays independently. In other words, the outer display can stay locked in portrait, while the inner display remains free to rotate as you open and reposition the phone.

For example, you could keep the outer display locked in portrait for reading while reclining on the sofa, but leave the inner display free to rotate into landscape for watching videos, without having to toggle Orientation Lock each time.
The lock applies only to the display you are using when you enable it, so set each display separately like so:
Open Control Center by swiping down from the top-right corner of the screen or by tapping the circular status bar below the clock.
Tap the Orientation Lock button (the padlock with a circular arrow around it).
Repeat on the other display if you want a different setting there.
The only caveat worth keeping in mind is that videos still rotate automatically when the Duo is propped up in "tent mode," regardless of Orientation Lock.

evidence.title: 微软 Surface Duo 2 变“苹果 iPhone Duo”：铺路原生运行 iOS 26，双屏触控已可用

units.text: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Latest 昨日（10 月 27 日）发布博文，分享了来自开发者 @none24smu 的更多图片，展示了微软 Surface Duo 2 手机成功运行 iOS 26 系统。
iOS 26 已在微软 Surface Duo 2 上原生运行。
微软 Surface Duo 2 是微软于 2021 年推出的双屏安卓手机，也是 Surface Duo 系列的第二代、也是最后一款产品。它采用两块 5.8 英寸 OLED 屏幕通过铰链相连，展开后形成约 8.3 英寸的“双屏平板”体验。
需要注意的是，本次并非通过模拟器实现，开发者在 Surface Duo 上原生运行苹果 iOS 26 系统，而且在今天（10 月 28 日）发布的推文中，还表示正适配 iOS 27 系统。
在实现方式上，开发者利用苹果开源的 XNU 内核和自定义 UEFI 加载器完成移植，并将该设备识别为“iPhone 17 Pro Max”。
开发者需要从源代码编译 XNU 内核，为高通处理器编写驱动，并构建 Metal 图形 API 到 Vulkan 的转换层，让 Surface Duo 2 的 Adreno 660 GPU 能运行 iOS 图形指令。
Surface Duo 2 两块屏幕上的 iOS 26 语言选择器，并叠加显示启动日志。
iOS 在安卓手机上启动。
由于骁龙 888 不支持苹果的指针认证机制，开发者还移除了约 2,960 万个指针签名，并将部分 arm64e 代码改写为 arm64。IT之家附上相关图片如下：
开发者写道：“两个显示器都以 37fps 的帧率运行 —— 以前是 3-10fps”，紧接着又写道：“触摸功能正常了！”，这简直太棒了。
在该开发者分享的图片中，Surface Duo 移植 iOS 26 系统后，在设置应用中的“关于本机”页面显示系统版本为 iOS 26.5.2，型号为“iPhone 17 Pro Max”，内存容量为 5GB，序列号、Wi-Fi 地址和蓝牙信息均显示为“N/A”。
Surface Duo 2 上的 iOS 26.5.2 在“设置”中显示为 iPhone 17 Pro Max。
据报道，移植版 iOS 26.5.2 已能同时点亮 Surface Duo 2 的两块屏幕，触控功能也可正常使用。系统将双屏视为一个整体画布，“设置”等应用可跨屏显示，并呈现 iOS 26 的液态玻璃界面效果。
iOS 26 设置界面采用液态玻璃技术，横跨 Surface Duo 2 的两块屏幕。
不过，该项目仍处于早期研究阶段：壁纸显示异常、Wi‑Fi 和蓝牙信息为空，部分界面还存在图形错误；电话应用的数字键盘也会被机身铰链遮挡。
在运行于 Surface Duo 2 上的 iOS 26 中设置壁纸。
iOS 26 手机键盘的中间一列被 Surface Duo 2 的铰链遮挡住了。
Surface Duo 2 上的 iOS 通话屏幕。
Surface Duo 2 上的 iOS 26 通讯录屏幕仍然存在图形错误。
微软已于 2024 年 10 月停止支持 Surface Duo 2，但这一移植项目让这款被放弃的设备重新获得关注。开发者表示，项目耗时约两个月，过程中也借助 AI 工具理解 XNU 内核的部分机制。下一步，他计划让 Surface Pen 模拟 Apple Pencil，并尝试移植 iOS 27。

units.text: Apple CEO John Ternus Teases Touchscreen MacBooks: 12 Final Rumors

In a post on X today, Apple CEO John Ternus shared a short video that shows an Apple logo being projected onto a dark wall against a nighttime city skyline. This teaser comes just a few hours before Apple is expected to announce new MacBook models with touch-enabled OLED displays, so it is very likely in reference to that.

Apple invited selected tech reporters and content creators to a "Pro and tell" experience in Los Angeles at 10 a.m. Pacific Time today. There, guests will likely receive hands-on time with the touchscreen MacBook models, along with the new iPad mini, iMac, and 14-inch MacBook Pro models that Apple already announced earlier this week.
https://t.co/2XsfEhVRJH — John Ternus (@johnternus) October 28, 2026
Here are 12 final rumors for the touchscreen MacBook models:
14-inch and 16-inch models
OLED display with higher contrast, more vivid colors, and increased maximum brightness
Touch input, alongside keyboard and trackpad
A revamped, firmer hinge that prevents the display from wobbling when it is touched
A redesigned cooling system that improves airflow through the hinge
Dynamic Island instead of a notch
Thinner bezels around the display
Noticeably lower weight
A slightly thinner design
M5 Pro and M5 Max chips
macOS Golden Gate will have touchscreen optimizations and touch-specific controls
In the U.S., pricing is expected to start at or above $2,899 for the 14-inch model and at or above $3,399 for the 16-inch model
It is likely that the touchscreen MacBook models will be available to pre-order starting at exactly 10:10 a.m. Pacific Time today.

Other features include a Dynamic Island, a redesigned hinge that keeps the display steady when touched, thinner bezels, and a slimmer and lighter body. evidence.title: 苹果发布14英寸M6 MacBook Pro CPU升级12核 图形性能最高提升30%

units.text: 苹果于10月27日正式发布搭载M6芯片的新款14英寸MacBook Pro。这是苹果新一代自研处理器首次进入MacBook Pro产品线。与上一代搭载M5芯片的机型相比，新款产品主要升级了处理器、图形性能、人工智能运算能力和无线连接规格，但机身设计及其他主要配置基本保持不变。
新款MacBook Pro搭载的M6芯片采用12核CPU架构，包括2个超级核心、4个性能核心和6个能效核心。相比之下，M5芯片采用10核CPU，由4个超级核心和6个能效核心组成。M6不仅增加了核心数量，也重新调整了核心类型的分配方式，试图在高负载性能与日常能耗之间取得更好的平衡。
图形处理方面，M6配备12核GPU，而上一代M5配备10核GPU。苹果表示，与M5相比，M6的图形性能最高提升30%，人工智能工作负载的处理速度最高提升25%。这些改进有望让新款MacBook Pro在图形渲染、视频处理、游戏以及部分本地人工智能任务中获得更好的表现。
人工智能运算能力也是此次升级的重点。M6采用双16核神经网络引擎系统，总计32个核心，而M5配备16核神经网络引擎。苹果还在GPU中加入额外的神经网络加速器，以提高设备运行人工智能模型的效率。
苹果表示，M6将进一步增强MacBook Pro运行Apple Intelligence功能以及本地大型语言模型的能力。相比依赖云端服务器处理数据，本地运行模型能够减少部分任务对网络连接的依赖，并有助于保护用户隐私。不过，实际表现仍取决于模型规模、统一内存容量以及软件对新硬件的优化程度。
内存带宽也有所提升。对于配备24GB或32GB内存的配置，M6的内存带宽达到170GB/s，高于M5的153GB/s，提升约11.1%。更高的内存带宽有助于CPU、GPU和神经网络引擎更快地访问共享数据，对于图形计算和人工智能工作负载尤其重要。但苹果公布的这一提升幅度仅适用于24GB和32GB内存版本，不能直接套用于所有配置。
无线连接方面，新款14英寸MacBook Pro加入Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6支持，并通过苹果自研的N1无线芯片实现相关功能。Wi-Fi 7在兼容路由器和网络环境下能够提供更高的传输能力和更低的延迟，蓝牙6则进一步更新了无线连接标准。
外接显示器能力也得到小幅提升。新款MacBook Pro可以同时驱动两台4K外接显示器，刷新率最高达到165Hz，高于上一代支持的144Hz。对于需要多屏办公、视频编辑或高刷新率显示设备的用户而言，这一改进提供了更大的使用灵活性。
存储方面，新款14英寸MacBook Pro继续以1TB固态硬盘起步。苹果此前已在2026年3月取消上一代产品的512GB入门配置，因此此次发布并非从512GB直接提升至1TB，而是延续现有的存储容量安排。
相比内部硬件升级，外观变化则相当有限。苹果表示，新款14英寸MacBook Pro的其他配置基本沿用上一代设计，没有同步引入全面重新设计的机身，也没有在此次更新中加入传闻已久的OLED触控屏。
新款产品的美国起售价为1999美元，预购将于10月28日开始，正式上市时间为11月6日。与部分消费者期待的入门级MacBook Pro降价不同，新款机型依然定位于专业笔记本电脑市场。
值得注意的是，这次发布并不意味着苹果已经完成整个MacBook Pro产品线的更新。市场此前持续传出，苹果正在准备采用OLED显示屏、支持触控操作并重新设计机身的高端MacBook Pro。不过，这些产品预计将采用M5 Pro和M5 Max芯片，而不是直接推出M6 Pro和M6 Max版本。
此前的报道还指出，苹果可能跳过M6 Pro和M6 Max，直接在2027年推出M7系列高性能芯片。若这一规划属实，标准版M6 MacBook Pro的产品周期可能相对较短，而真正的大规模设计变化将留给下一代高端机型。

从产品定位来看，此次更新更像是一次以芯片为核心的常规迭代。M6带来了更多CPU和GPU核心、更强的神经网络处理能力以及新一代无线连接技术，但对现有用户而言，是否值得升级仍取决于工作负载。对于仍在使用较早期Apple Silicon或英特尔处理器的用户，新款机型可能具有较明显的性能吸引力；而已经使用M5 MacBook Pro的用户，则需要结合实际应用需求，衡量最高30%的图形性能提升和人工智能运算改进是否足以抵消升级成本。

evidence.title: iOS 27.2新增年龄验证功能 自拍就能验证是否成年

units.text: 苹果又给iPhone加入了一项新功能，苹果在iOS 27.2中新增自拍年龄验证方式，用户在需要确认是否成年的场景下，可以通过自拍让系统估算年龄，不一定非要掏出身份证或使用信用卡验证。据了解，随着越来越多国家和地区要求对用户进行年龄验证，iPhone用户在创建Apple账户、更新系统、下载应用或调整部分设置时，都可能需要先确认自己是否成年。
据9to5Mac报道，目前，澳大利亚、巴西、新加坡、韩国、英国以及美国得克萨斯州等地区，已在部分场景中实施相关年龄验证要求。
此前，苹果已支持信用卡验证、扫描身份证件等方式，此次iOS 27.2又增加了自拍选项，相当于给用户提供了另一种选择。
具体操作也不复杂，用户选择自拍验证后，需要将面部对准取景框，再按照屏幕提示缓慢向右、向左、向上和向下转动头部，完成四个方向的面部采集。
随后，系统会通过年龄估算模型分析面部图像，判断用户是否达到成年年龄。
隐私方面，苹果表示，年龄估算模型会在设备本地和私有云计算环境中运行。
自拍图像不会向任何人开放，包括苹果自身，在完成年龄确认后，相关自拍照片会立即删除，不会以任何形式留存。
